textos.2 doses com intervalo mínimo de 1 mês. G: 2 doses at least 1 month apart. Groups at high risk of invasive meningococcal disease have a different schedule and boosters.

textos.Avaliar policitemia secundária à hipoxem: Assess polycythemia secondary to chronic hypoxemia and rule out anemia that may worsen dyspnea.
textos.Avaliação da função hepática em paciente: Liver function assessment in patients with diabetes. Important before starting statins and to screen for nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).
textos.Avaliação da função renal Avaliação de f: Kidney function assessment. Interval of 3-6 months when nephrotoxic drugs are used (eGFR below 60 mL/min/1.73 m² or increased risk of kidney disease).
textos.Avaliação de albuminúria para detecção p: Albuminuria assessment for early detection of kidney damage in people with hypertension
textos.Avaliação de dislipidemia. Intervalo de: Dyslipidemia assessment. Interval of 6-12 months if the last result was abnormal. HIV and ART may increase cardiovascular risk.
textos.Avaliação de distúrbios eletrolíticos e: Assessment of electrolyte disturbances and investigation of secondary hypertension
textos.Avaliação de distúrbios eletrolíticos. I: Assessment of electrolyte disturbances. Important in patients with severe COPD or on diuretics.
textos.Avaliação de função hepática. Intervalos: Liver function assessment. More frequent intervals with hepatotoxic drugs, liver disease or HCV/HBV.
textos.Avaliação de hipertrofia ventricular esq: Assessment of left ventricular hypertrophy, diastolic function and target-organ damage in people with hypertension
textos.Avaliação de risco cardiovascular e rena: Cardiovascular and renal risk assessment in patients with hypertension
textos.Avaliação do metabolismo ósseo e risco d: Assessment of bone metabolism and osteoporosis risk in patients with diabetes.
textos.Avaliação do metabolismo ósseo em pacien: Assessment of bone metabolism in patients with diabetes, especially with kidney disease or osteoporosis. Vitamin D deficiency is common in diabetes.
textos.Avaliação do risco cardiovascular em pac: Cardiovascular risk assessment in patients with diabetes. Perform yearly, or more often if on treatment for dyslipidemia.
textos.Avaliação hematológica em pacientes diab: Hematologic assessment in patients with diabetes. Important to detect anemia, infections and other hematologic changes.

textos.BRCA1/2 na família: ressonância magnétic: BRCA1/2 in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 25, alternating with or added to mammography.

textos.CDH1 na família: ressonância magnética d: CDH1 in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 30, alternating with or added to mammography.
textos.CDH1: endoscopia digestiva alta anual co: CDH1: yearly upper GI endoscopy with multiple biopsies (Cambridge protocol) for those who postpone gastrectomy.
textos.Cirrose: rastreamento de carcinoma hepat: Cirrhosis: hepatocellular carcinoma screening with ultrasound every 6 months (with or without alpha-fetoprotein).
textos.Citologia a cada 3 anos dos 21 aos 29 an: Cytology every 3 years from 21 to 29 years (USPSTF). In Brazil, the Ministry of Health recommends HPV DNA testing every 5 years from age 25, where available.
textos.Clamídia: rastreio na primeira consulta: Chlamydia: screening at the first visit for all. Gonorrhea: for those under 25 or with a risk factor. Repeat in the 3rd trimester if under 25 or at risk.

textos.Dose única a cada gestação. SBIm/PNI: a: Single dose in each pregnancy. SBIm/PNI: from 28 weeks (24-27 at the physician's discretion). ACOG/CDC: 32 to 36 weeks, preferably during the season. The only RSV vaccine licensed for pregnant women.
textos.Dose única anual. Com fator de risco e s: Single yearly dose. With a risk factor and depending on the epidemiological situation, consider a 2nd dose 3 months after the yearly dose.
textos.Dose única anual. Para 60+ a SBIm prefer: Single yearly dose. For 60+ SBIm prefers HD3V; if unavailable, use standard 3V or 4V. With a risk factor and depending on the epidemiological situation, consider a 2nd dose 3 months later.
textos.Dose única para 60-69 anos com maior ris: Single dose for ages 60-69 at higher risk: heart disease, lung disease, diabetes, obesity, kidney disease, liver disease, immunosuppression, frailty or institutionalization.
textos.Dose única para adultos com asma moderad: Single dose for adults with moderate or severe asthma.
textos.Dose única para adultos com doença respi: Single dose for adults with clinically relevant chronic respiratory or cardiovascular disease (COPD, moderate/severe asthma, heart failure, coronary disease, moderate/severe immunodeficiency).
textos.Dose única, conforme situação epidemioló: Single dose, according to the epidemiological situation (outbreak, travel to a risk area). Without ACWY, use meningococcal C conjugate.
textos.Dose única, em qualquer época do ano. Ro: Single dose, at any time of year. Routine from age 70, regardless of risk factors. May be given together with the other vaccines for the age.
textos.Dose única. Indicada em qualquer idade c: Single dose. Indicated at any age with a comorbidity that raises the risk of invasive pneumococcal disease.
textos.Dose única. Já recebeu VPP23: aguardar 1: Single dose. Already received PPSV23: wait 1 year. Incomplete series with PCV13/PCV15 (± PPSV23): complete with PCV20 (2 months after PCV13/15 or 1 year after PPSV23). Complete series (PCV13/15 + PPSV23): additional dose at the physician's discretion.
textos.ECG de 12 derivações - Rastreamento card: 12-lead ECG - cardiovascular screening for hypertension, diabetes or age ≥40
textos.Esquema completo: reforço com dTpa a cad: Complete series: Tdap booster every 10 years. Incomplete: 1 dose of Tdap and complete with Td up to 3 doses with a tetanus component. Unvaccinated/unknown: 1 Tdap + 2 Td (0-2-4 to 8 months). Contact of an infant: consider bringing the booster forward to 5 years. Travel to an area with polio: Tdap-IPV.
textos.Exame de imagem para avaliar complicaçõe: Imaging to assess complications (pneumonia, pneumothorax, heart failure) and exclude other differential diagnoses.
textos.Exame essencial para confirmar o diagnós: Essential test to confirm the diagnosis of COPD, grade the severity of airflow obstruction and monitor disease progression. It should be performed after a bronchodilator.
textos.Fator de risco para diabetes: rastrear d: Risk factor for diabetes: screen for undiagnosed diabetes before 15 weeks.
textos.Fratura de quadril em pai ou mãe é fator: A hip fracture in the father or mother is a major risk factor for fracture: screen before age 65 (postmenopausal women) and men aged 50 to 69 with a risk factor.
textos.Gestante Rh negativo: repetir com 28 sem: Rh-negative pregnant woman: repeat at 28 weeks; if negative, anti-D immunoglobulin at 28 weeks and up to 72 h after delivery (if the newborn is Rh positive).
textos.Hepatite viral crônica: vacinar os susce: Chronic viral hepatitis: vaccinate susceptible people against hepatitis A (and against hepatitis B, in hepatitis C).
textos.Hepatopatia crônica: vacinar contra hepa: Chronic liver disease: vaccinate susceptible people against hepatitis A and B, at any age.
textos.Hipercolesterolemia familiar em parente: Familial hypercholesterolemia in a first-degree relative: lipid panel at any age (cascade screening). LDL-C ≥ 190 mg/dL suggests FH.
textos.Hipertireoidismo: TSH (com T4 livre) a c: Hyperthyroidism: TSH (with free T4) every 4-8 weeks until controlled and then every 3-6 months.
textos.Hiponatremia por diurético, sobretudo em: Diuretic-induced hyponatremia, especially in older adults.
textos.Hipotireoidismo em reposição: TSH anual: Hypothyroidism on replacement: yearly TSH on a stable dose (6-8 weeks after an adjustment).
textos.Imunobiológico ou inibidor de JAK: rastr: Biologic or JAK inhibitor: screen for hepatitis B before treatment (risk of reactivation, especially with rituximab).
textos.Inibidor de aromatase: densitometria no: Aromatase inhibitor: densitometry at the start of treatment and every 1-2 years.
textos.Investigação de apneia obstrutiva do son: Investigation of obstructive sleep apnea, a common cause of resistant hypertension. Indicated for patients with snoring, excessive daytime sleepiness or breathing pauses during sleep.
textos.Investigação de estenose de artéria rena: Investigation of renal artery stenosis as a cause of secondary hypertension. Indicated in patients with resistant hypertension, abrupt onset of severe hypertension, or worsening kidney function after an ACE inhibitor/ARB.
textos.Início do pré-natal fora das janelas de: Prenatal care started outside the ultrasound windows: dating, viability and fetal assessment.
textos.Li-Fraumeni (protocolo de Toronto): ress: Li-Fraumeni (Toronto protocol): yearly whole-body and brain MRI, without contrast when possible.
textos.Li-Fraumeni na família: colonoscopia a c: Li-Fraumeni in the family: colonoscopy every 2-5 years, from age 25.
textos.Li-Fraumeni na família: ressonância magn: Li-Fraumeni in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 20, alternating with or added to mammography.
textos.Medição única na vida adulta para refina: Single measurement in adult life to refine cardiovascular risk. Prefer an isoform-independent assay.
textos.Monitoramento de citopenias relacionadas: Monitoring of cytopenias related to HIV or ART. Repeat in 2-8 weeks when starting or switching ART with zidovudine or other myelotoxic drugs.
textos.Monitoramento de eletrólitos em paciente: Electrolyte monitoring in patients with COPD, especially those on diuretics or corticosteroids. Hypokalemia may occur with beta-agonists.
textos.Monitoramento imunológico de pacientes H: Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: 150 cells/mm³. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.
Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: 350 cells/mm³. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.
Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: 700 cells/mm³. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.
Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: not informed. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.

Virologic monitoring. Current viral load: not informed. Goal: <50 copies/mL (undetectable). Confirms ART efficacy and adherence to treatment.
textos.Monitorização de toxicidade em uso de ci: Toxicity monitoring on cyclosporine or tacrolimus.
MEN1: yearly calcium, PTH and prolactin.
textos.NEM2 / carcinoma medular de tireoide fam: MEN2 / familial medullary thyroid carcinoma: yearly calcitonin, metanephrines and calcium.
MEN2 / familial medullary thyroid carcinoma: neck ultrasound.
textos.Pai ou irmão com câncer de próstata: ofe: Father or brother with prostate cancer: offer screening from age 45, with shared decision-making.
textos.Painel lipídico completo (não jejum): Co: Complete lipid panel (non-fasting): total cholesterol, HDL-C, triglycerides, calculated LDL-C and non-HDL-C. Screening every 4-6 years. Consider ApoB if triglycerides are high, or with diabetes or obesity.

Complete lipid panel (non-fasting): total cholesterol, HDL-C, triglycerides, calculated LDL-C and non-HDL-C. Screening every 4-6 years. Consider ApoB if triglycerides are high, or with diabetes or obesity. Dyslipidemia assessment. Interval of 6-12 months if the last result was abnormal. HIV and ART may increase cardiovascular risk.
textos.Para não vacinados previamente: 3 doses: For those not previously vaccinated: 3 doses (0-1-6 months). Hepatitis A at 60+ only in special situations (negative serology, exposure, outbreak).
textos.Para não vacinados: combinada A+B em 3 d: For the unvaccinated: combined A+B in 3 doses (0-1-6 months), or separate vaccines — hepatitis A in 2 doses (0-6 months) and hepatitis B in 3 doses (0-1-6 months). Hepatitis B is free in the PNI; hepatitis A and the combined vaccine, only in private clinics. Indicate only the missing component.
textos.Para o cálculo do FIB-4 (idade, AST, ALT: For calculating FIB-4 (age, AST, ALT, platelets): stratifies the risk of advanced fibrosis; FIB-4 ≥ 1.3 calls for elastography.
textos.Para suscetíveis (sem doença ou vacinaçã: For susceptible people (no previous disease or vaccination): 2 doses 1 to 2 months apart. Consider MMRV if MMR is also needed.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com aneurisma de aort: First-degree relative with an abdominal aortic aneurysm: ultrasound once between ages 65 and 75, in men and women.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com aneurisma ou diss: First-degree relative with a thoracic aortic aneurysm or dissection (or Marfan syndrome): imaging of the aortic root and ascending aorta.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com cardiomiopatia di: First-degree relative with familial dilated cardiomyopathy: ECG and echocardiogram every 3-5 years in adults (earlier if symptoms appear).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com cardiomiopatia hi: First-degree relative with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: ECG and echocardiogram every 3-5 years in adults (earlier if symptoms appear).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com deficiência de al: First-degree relative with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency: serum level (and genotyping if low).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com doença celíaca: s: First-degree relative with celiac disease: serology (tissue transglutaminase IgA with total IgA), on a gluten-containing diet.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com doença renal poli: First-degree relative with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease: kidney ultrasound in the at-risk adult, after counseling on the implications of the diagnosis.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com hemocromatose her: First-degree relative with hereditary hemochromatosis: ferritin and transferrin saturation; if abnormal, test for HFE gene mutations.
textos.Pesquisa de anticorpos irregulares na pr: Irregular antibody screen at the first visit, for all pregnant women. If Rh negative, repeat at 28 weeks.
textos.Polipose adenomatosa familiar: colonosco: Familial adenomatous polyposis: yearly colonoscopy, from age 18.
textos.Polipose adenomatosa familiar: endoscopi: Familial adenomatous polyposis: upper GI endoscopy with assessment of the papilla from age 20-25; interval according to the Spigelman stage.
textos.Protocolo Einstein; não é rastreio unive: Einstein protocol; not universal screening in the Ministry of Health or ACOG guidance.
Yearly lung cancer screening. Indicated for adults aged 50-80 with a 20 pack-year smoking history who currently smoke or quit within the past 15 years. Discontinue once the person has not smoked for 15 years or develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy.
textos.Rastreamento de HIV conforme PCDT-IST MS: HIV screening according to the Brazilian STI protocol (PCDT-IST MS 2022). Adolescents and young adults should be tested yearly.
textos.Rastreamento de alterações renais. Inter: Screening for kidney changes. Interval of 3-6 months with nephrotoxic drugs, proteinuria or increased risk of kidney disease.
textos.Rastreamento de aneurisma de aorta abdom: Abdominal aortic aneurysm screening. Men aged 65-75 with COPD or a smoking history ≥10 pack-years.
textos.Rastreamento de disfunção tireoidiana em: Screening for thyroid dysfunction in patients with diabetes, especially type 1. Diabetes and thyroid disease often coexist.
textos.Rastreamento de feocromocitoma em pacien: Screening for pheochromocytoma in patients with resistant hypertension, especially with hypertensive crises, headache, palpitations or excessive sweating.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B (HBsAg). Vaci: Hepatitis B screening (HBsAg). Vaccinate non-immune people (anti-HBs negative). Immune people do not need further HBV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B (anti-HBs). V: Hepatitis B screening (anti-HBs). Vaccinate non-immune people (anti-HBs negative). Immune people do not need further HBV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B. Vacinar pess: Hepatitis B screening. Vaccinate non-immune people (anti-HBs negative). Immune people do not need further HBV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite C. Solicitar ca: Hepatitis C screening. Order HCV viral load if anti-HCV is positive or acute infection is suspected.
textos.Rastreamento de hiperaldosteronismo prim: Screening for primary aldosteronism, an important cause of resistant hypertension. Collect in the morning after 2 hours upright. A ratio >20-30 suggests aldosteronism.
textos.Rastreamento de nefropatia diabética. Va: Screening for diabetic kidney disease. Values ≥30 mg/g indicate albuminuria and increased risk of kidney disease. Perform yearly.
textos.Rastreamento de osteoporose para preveni: Osteoporosis screening to prevent osteoporotic fractures. Women ≥65 years.
textos.Rastreamento de pré-diabetes e diabetes: Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Reference values: <100 mg/dL normal, 100-125 mg/dL prediabetes, ≥126 mg/dL diabetes.

Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Reference values: <100 mg/dL normal, 100-125 mg/dL prediabetes, ≥126 mg/dL diabetes. Diabetes screening. Some antiretrovirals may increase the risk of hyperglycemia.
Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Reference values: <5.7% normal, 5.7-6.4% prediabetes, ≥6.5% diabetes. Reflects glycemic control over the past 2-3 months.
textos.Rastreamento de retinopatia diabética. R: Diabetic retinopathy screening. Perform a complete dilated eye exam yearly. Diabetic retinopathy is the leading cause of blindness in adults.
textos.Rastreamento de sífilis. Considerar maio: Syphilis screening. Consider more frequent screening with risk or exposure. Non-immune people (anti-HBs negative) do not need further HIV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de tuberculose latente em u: Latent tuberculosis screening on a biologic or JAK inhibitor; with a positive result and active disease ruled out, treat.
textos.Rastreio de colo curto (≤ 25 mm). Com pa: Screening for a short cervix (≤ 25 mm). With a previous preterm birth, measure from 16 weeks.
textos.Rastreio de diabetes gestacional para to: Gestational diabetes screening for all women without a previous diagnosis. IADPSG/WHO criteria: fasting ≥ 92, 1 h ≥ 180 or 2 h ≥ 153 mg/dL (one value is enough).

Gestational diabetes screening for all women without a previous diagnosis. IADPSG/WHO criteria: fasting ≥ 92, 1 h ≥ 180 or 2 h ≥ 153 mg/dL (one value is enough). Outside the 24-28 week window: if not yet done, do it right away.
textos.Repetir a cada trimestre enquanto suscet: Repeat every trimester while susceptible (IgG negative).
Repeat in the 3rd trimester (Einstein/Ministry of Health).
textos.Reteste no 3º trimestre para menores de: Retest in the 3rd trimester for those under 25 or with a risk factor.
SBIm: 2 doses 10 years apart. PNI: single dose if the first was given from age 5. For the international certificate (ICVP), give it up to 10 days before travel.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden (PTEN): ultrassonogra: Cowden syndrome (PTEN): kidney ultrasound every 1-2 years from age 40.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden na família: colonosco: Cowden syndrome in the family: colonoscopy every 5 years, from age 35.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden na família: mamografi: Cowden syndrome in the family: yearly mammography from age 30.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden na família: ressonânc: Cowden syndrome in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 30, alternating with or added to mammography.
textos.Síndrome de Lynch na família: colonoscop: Lynch syndrome in the family: colonoscopy every 1-2 years, from age 20.
textos.Síndrome de Lynch: endoscopia digestiva: Lynch syndrome: upper GI endoscopy with biopsies and H. pylori testing every 2-4 years, from age 30-40.
textos.Teste de HPV de alto risco a cada 5 anos: High-risk HPV test every 5 years from 30 to 65 years. Alternatives: cytology alone every 3 years or co-testing every 5 years.
textos.Teste de resistência genotípica (PR/RT +: Genotypic resistance test (PR/RT +/- integrase gene). Indicated before starting ART and in virologic failure. Essential for choosing the appropriate regimen.
textos.Toxicidade tireoidiana e hepática da ami: Thyroid and liver toxicity of amiodarone.
textos.Uso prolongado de metformina associa-se: Long-term metformin use is associated with B12 deficiency; measure periodically, especially with anemia or neuropathy.
textos.Vacina inativada: 2 doses (0-2 meses; 1-: Inactivated vaccine: 2 doses (0-2 months; 1-2 months apart if immunosuppressed). Indicated from age 18 in immunocompromised people.
textos.Vacinados na infância: reforço aos 11 an: Vaccinated in childhood: booster at age 11 or 5 years after the last dose. Unvaccinated from age 16: single dose. Without ACWY, use meningococcal C conjugate.
textos.Varfarina: INR a cada 4 semanas com dose: Warfarin: INR every 4 weeks on a stable dose (up to 12 weeks if the INR is consistently in range).
textos.Aneurisma cerebral em 2 ou mais parentes: Brain aneurysm in 2 or more first-degree relatives

textos.Cardiomiopatia dilatada familiar na famí: Familial dilated cardiomyopathy in the family
textos.Deficiência de alfa-1 antitripsina na fa: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency in the family

textos.Agravante de risco cardiovascular (já co: Cardiovascular risk enhancer (already considered in the SBC category). At intermediate risk, the coronary calcium score may reclassify.
textos.Aplicar os critérios da Dutch Lipid Clin: Apply the Dutch Lipid Clinic Network criteria; cascade genetic testing when the family variant is known. In confirmed FH, risk is not estimated by a score: treat as high risk.
textos.Avaliação oftalmológica com tonometria e: Eye exam with tonometry and fundoscopy every 1-2 years from age 40.
textos.Com câncer colorretal ou de endométrio e: With colorectal or endometrial cancer in first-degree relatives, especially before age 50, consider Lynch syndrome and refer for genetic counseling.
textos.Considerar profilaxia de pneumocistose q: Consider Pneumocystis prophylaxis when there is another immunosuppression factor (another immunosuppressant, hematologic malignancy, vasculitis) and treat or test for strongyloidiasis before maintaining a high dose (endemic area).
textos.Considerar teste genético quando há sínd: Consider genetic testing when there is a known syndrome or variant; if the ascending aorta is not well seen on echocardiography, CT angiography or MR angiography.
textos.Dois ou mais parentes de 1º grau acometi: Two or more affected first-degree relatives, or a known hereditary syndrome, call for assessment at a referral center (MRI or endoscopic ultrasound). A single relative does not indicate screening.
textos.Exame dermatológico de corpo inteiro per: Periodic full-body skin exam and sun-protection counseling.
textos.Exame oftalmológico basal no primeiro an: Baseline eye exam in the first year and yearly retinopathy screening after 5 years of use (earlier if the dose is > 5 mg/kg/day, with kidney disease or with tamoxifen use).
textos.Item marcado implica imunossupressão: a: A selected item implies immunosuppression: the vaccine screening was treated as "Yes" and live attenuated vaccines are not included.
textos.Oferecer aconselhamento e teste genético: Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing when the family variant is known; a negative test for the variant ends the follow-up.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Complete physical and neurologic exam every 6-12 months, yearly skin exam and upper GI endoscopy together with colonoscopy. Avoid ionizing radiation whenever there is an alternative.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Women: counsel about abnormal uterine bleeding and consider endometrial screening from age 35.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. In carriers of a pathogenic CDH1 variant, discuss prophylactic total gastrectomy between ages 18 and 40.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. In carriers, colonoscopy starts at 10-15 years; discuss colectomy according to the polyp burden. Consider thyroid ultrasound.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. In carriers: yearly gastrin and pancreatic imaging; pituitary MRI every 3-5 years.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. RET gene testing defines management: in carriers, prophylactic thyroidectomy at the age indicated by the risk of the mutation.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Female carriers: discuss risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy (35-40 years in BRCA1, 40-45 in BRCA2) and risk-reducing mastectomy. Male carriers: clinical breast exam from age 35. Pancreas: screen carriers who also have a family case of pancreatic cancer.
textos.Oferecer teste genético em cascata quand: Offer cascade genetic testing when the family variant is known; depending on the syndrome, exercise test or Holter. Review QT-prolonging drugs.
textos.Pesar o risco antes de prescrever estrog: Weigh the risk before prescribing estrogen (combined contraceptive, hormone therapy). Thrombophilia testing is not routine in asymptomatic people.
textos.Pesquisar e tratar Helicobacter pylori;: Test for and treat Helicobacter pylori; endoscopy according to symptoms and individual risk.
textos.Sem a dose, foi tratado como imunossupre: Without the dose, it was treated as immunosuppressive. Up to 0.4 mg/kg/week (or 20 mg/week, without the weight) counts as low-level immunosuppression.
textos.Sem dose e peso, foi tratada como imunos: Without dose and weight, it was treated as immunosuppressive. Up to 3 mg/kg/day counts as low-level immunosuppression.

textos.Febre amarela: contraindicada na gestaçã: Yellow fever: contraindicated in pregnancy. If it cannot be postponed (outbreak or epidemiological emergency), the health service must weigh risk and benefit.

textos.Vacina de vírus vivo atenuado em pessoa: Live attenuated vaccine in a person living with HIV with CD4+ T cells from 200 cells/mm³: individualized indication, according to the CD4 range and the clinical situation.
Live attenuated vaccine in a person living with HIV: enter the recent CD4+ T-cell count to assess the indication.
textos.Vacina de vírus vivo atenuado: contraind: Live attenuated vaccine: contraindicated in immunosuppression. Exceptions depend on the degree of immunosuppression and must be assessed case by case.

textos.Dosar a digoxinemia (no vale, pelo menos: Measure serum digoxin (trough, at least 6 h after the dose) if toxicity is suspected, renal function worsens, an interacting drug is started (amiodarone, verapamil, diltiazem, clarithromycin) or the dose changes. In heart failure, keep 0.5-0.9 ng/mL: concentrations ≥ 1.0 ng/mL were associated with higher mortality. Check potassium and renal function, which change the risk of toxicity.

Serum lithium drawn 12 hours after the last dose (10 to 14 h is acceptable, always at the same interval). Usual maintenance target 0.6 to 0.8 mmol/L. textos.Primeiro ano de uso: litemia a cada 3 me: First year of use: serum lithium every 3 months (before that, 1 week after starting and after each dose change until stable). Then every 6 months, or every 3 months in older people, with ACE inhibitors/ARBs, diuretics or NSAIDs, with a last level ≥ 0.8 mmol/L, poor adherence or poor symptom control. Weight or BMI every 6 months. ECG at the start if there is cardiovascular disease or risk.
textos.Valproato, carbamazepina, fenitoína e fe: Valproate, carbamazepine, phenytoin and phenobarbital: routine serum levels are not recommended. Measure them if poor adherence or toxicity is suspected, to adjust phenytoin dose, for pharmacokinetic interactions or in special situations (pregnancy, renal or hepatic failure). Write the time of the last dose on the request.

textos.Colposcopia sem doença após HPV detectad: Colposcopy without disease after HPV detected: repeat the HPV DNA test in 12 months. Negative: back to every 3 years. Detected again: repeat colposcopy.
Colposcopy without disease after HPV detected: repeat the HPV DNA test in 12 months. Negative: back to every 5 years. HPV 16/18 again, or another type persisting for 24 months: repeat colposcopy.
textos.HIV ou imunossupressão: qualquer tipo on: HIV or immunosuppression: any oncogenic type detected calls for colposcopy, regardless of reflex cytology. No disease at colposcopy: repeat the HPV DNA test in 12 months.
textos.HIV ou imunossupressão: teste de DNA-HPV: HIV or immunosuppression: oncogenic HPV DNA test every 3 years, from the start of sexual activity and with no age to stop. Any oncogenic type detected calls for colposcopy.
textos.HPV 16 ou 18 detectado: colposcopia dire: HPV 16 or 18 detected: straight to colposcopy, regardless of cytology. No disease at colposcopy: repeat the HPV DNA test in 12 months.
textos.Outro tipo oncogênico (não 16-18) com ci: Another oncogenic type (not 16-18) with abnormal (ASC-US or worse) or unsatisfactory reflex cytology: colposcopy. No disease at colposcopy: repeat the HPV DNA test in 12 months.

Another oncogenic type (not 16-18) with negative reflex cytology: repeat the HPV DNA test in 12 months. Negative: back to every 5 years. HPV 16/18 or abnormal cytology on the new test: colposcopy. Any oncogenic type persisting for 24 months: colposcopy, even with negative cytology.

textos.Encerrar se o último teste de DNA-HPV, f: Stop if the last HPV DNA test, done after age 60, was negative (ACOG: after age 65, with adequate prior screening). Anyone never tested has one test; if negative, stop. With treated CIN2, CIN3 or adenocarcinoma in situ, keep screening for 25 years after treatment.
textos.Histerectomia total por doença benigna,: Total hysterectomy for benign disease, with no prior high-grade lesion and normal previous exams: screening can stop. If the hysterectomy was for a precursor lesion or cervical cancer, keep screening (vaginal sample) for at least 25 years; if the reason is uncertain, keep screening.
textos.MS 2025 e SBOC 2026: não rastrear antes: Brazilian Ministry of Health 2025 and SBOC 2026: no screening before age 25, with HPV testing or cytology (infection is usually transient and screening brings more colposcopies and treatments than benefit); from 25, HPV DNA test every 5 years, without cytology. ACOG 2026: cytology alone every 3 years from 21 to 29 and HPV testing every 5 years only from 30. Cytology every 3 years (ACOG) was kept. Under the Ministry of Health and SBOC, screening would start at 25 with HPV DNA testing: remove the item if you prefer to follow them.

textos.Teste de DNA-HPV oncogênico com genotipa: Oncogenic HPV DNA test with genotyping every 5 years, from 25 to 65, without cytology at the same time (co-testing is not recommended). HPV 16/18: colposcopy. Other types: reflex cytology on the same sample. Where the test is not available: cytology every 3 years, after two negative annual exams.

Oncogenic HPV DNA test with genotyping every 5 years, from 25 to 65, without cytology at the same time (co-testing is not recommended). HPV 16/18: colposcopy. Other types: reflex cytology on the same sample. Where the test is not available: cytology every 3 years, after two negative annual exams. After age 60, a negative test ends screening.
textos.Em TARV, assintomático e com carga viral: On ART, asymptomatic and with undetectable viral load: below 350 every 6 months; 350-500 yearly; above 500 in 2 tests 6 months apart, no longer needed. Off ART, clinical event or virologic failure: every 6 months. On prophylaxis or with an opportunistic infection: every 3 months.
textos.Supressão viral com estabilidade clínica: Viral suppression with clinical and immunologic stability: every 6 months. ART start or change: 8 weeks later. Detectable viral load: repeat in 4 weeks to confirm failure.
textos.Falha virológica confirmada (duas cargas: Confirmed virologic failure (two detectable viral loads, the last above 500 copies/mL): order genotyping as soon as possible. Below 500 copies/mL the test is not released in the Brazilian public system (SUS).
textos.Genotipagem pré-tratamento indicada na g: Pretreatment genotyping indicated in pregnancy (MS 2024, Box 4).
textos.Pelo MS a genotipagem pré-tratamento é s: Per the Brazilian Ministry of Health, pretreatment genotyping is only for people infected by a partner on ART, pregnant people, children and adolescents, PrEP use around the likely time of infection and TB-HIV coinfection; add it from the catalog in these cases. HIVMA/IDSA recommends baseline genotyping for everyone who has never taken ART.
textos.Pré-TARV e a cada 6-12 meses. Com zidovu: Before ART and every 6-12 months. With zidovudine or another myelotoxic drug: every 3-6 months, and repeat 2-8 weeks after starting or switching.
textos.Creatinina com TFGe: pré-TARV e anual; a: Creatinine with eGFR: before ART and yearly; every 3-6 months with tenofovir or another nephrotoxic drug, eGFR below 60 mL/min or kidney disease risk (diabetes, hypertension).
textos.Pré-TARV e anual; a cada 3-6 meses com t: Before ART and yearly; every 3-6 months with tenofovir or another nephrotoxic drug, eGFR below 60 mL/min, proteinuria or kidney disease risk.
textos.Painel bioquímico (eletrólitos, ureia e: Chemistry panel (electrolytes, urea and creatinine): 1-2 months after starting or switching ART and then every 6 months; off ART, every 6-12 months.
textos.AST, ALT, fosfatase alcalina e bilirrubi: AST, ALT, alkaline phosphatase and bilirubin: before ART and every 3-12 months; more often with hepatotoxic drugs, liver disease or HBV/HCV coinfection.
textos.Pré-TARV e anual; a cada 6 meses se a úl: Before ART and yearly; every 6 months if the last result was abnormal. HIVMA/IDSA accepts every 5 years if normal and asks for one measurement 1-3 months after starting ART.
textos.Glicemia de jejum pré-TARV e anual; entr: Fasting glucose before ART and yearly; between 100 and 125 mg/dL, consider an OGTT. HbA1c should not be used to diagnose diabetes in people with HIV (it underestimates glycemia on ART).
textos.Teste imunológico para sífilis pré-TARV: Syphilis immunologic test before ART and every 6 months; more often with risk or exposure. HIVMA/IDSA asks for at least yearly, every 3-6 months with risk.
textos.Teste molecular em todos os locais de ex: Molecular test at every site of sexual exposure (urine or vaginal swab, rectal and oropharyngeal swab). At entry and at least yearly; every 3-6 months depending on sexual practices.
textos.Quem tem relação vaginal receptiva: test: People who have receptive vaginal sex: molecular test on a vaginal or endocervical swab, at least yearly.
textos.Pré-TARV e anual ou conforme risco ou ex: Before ART and yearly, or according to risk or exposure. Reactive anti-HCV or suspected acute infection: order HCV viral load (HCV RNA). With low CD4 the antibody may miss infection: consider HCV RNA.
textos.Triagem de hepatite B na avaliação inici: Hepatitis B screening at the initial evaluation. Reactive HBsAg: HBV viral load. Vaccinate non-immune people; with reactive anti-HBs there is no need to repeat. Repeat serology before switching to a regimen without tenofovir.
textos.Imunidade para hepatite A na avaliação i: Hepatitis A immunity at the initial evaluation; non-reactive: vaccinate.
textos.IgG para toxoplasmose na avaliação inici: Toxoplasma IgG at the initial evaluation (guides prophylaxis when CD4 is low).
textos.Na avaliação inicial. Coinfecção com HTL: At the initial evaluation. HTLV coinfection may overestimate the absolute CD4 count.
textos.Pré-TARV com CD4 acima de 350; anual se: Before ART with CD4 above 350; yearly if the previous test was TST below 5 mm or negative IGRA. TST of 5 mm or more or positive IGRA: rule out active TB (symptoms and chest X-ray) and treat latent infection.

textos.Com CD4 abaixo de 350 o MS não pede prov: With CD4 below 350 the Brazilian Ministry of Health does not require a TST or IGRA: assess the criteria for tuberculosis preventive treatment (TPT) directly, after ruling out active TB (symptom screening at every visit and chest X-ray).
textos.Na abordagem inicial; também para afasta: At the initial evaluation; also to rule out active TB before treating latent infection.
textos.Rastreio de doença criptocócica mesmo se: Screening for cryptococcal disease even without symptoms, with CD4 below 200 and no prior cryptococcal meningitis (MS; HIVMA/IDSA uses CD4 below 100). Reactive: assess for lumbar puncture.
textos.Pessoa com potencial de engravidar: test: Person of childbearing potential: pregnancy test before starting ART.
textos.Teste de gravidez antes de iniciar ou tr: Pregnancy test before starting or switching ART in people who can become pregnant (HIVMA/IDSA). Chagas disease and leishmaniasis serology according to epidemiology (MS). Cardiovascular risk score yearly and at every ART switch (MS). Visits: 7-15 days after starting or switching ART; monthly or every 2 months until adaptation; up to every 6 months with viral suppression and no symptoms (MS).
textos.MS: toque retal anual em quem tem relaçã: MS: yearly digital rectal exam in people with receptive anal sex, prior HPV or abnormal vulvar or cervical histology; anoscopy if abnormal. HIVMA/IDSA: where high-resolution anoscopy is available, anal cytology with HPV testing for men who have sex with men and transgender women over 35 and for all other people with HIV over 45; LSIL or worse: high-resolution anoscopy. Yearly digital rectal exam for everyone.

The CD4 also defines opportunistic infection prophylaxis and the CD4 interval itself; the viral load defines the follow-up interval.

textos.Calcular o risco de câncer de mama ao lo: Calculate lifetime breast cancer risk (Tyrer-Cuzick/IBIS) by age 25. With risk of 20% or more: annual MRI from age 25-30 and annual mammography from 30. Below that: annual mammography from 40.

textos.Câncer de mama na família, por si só, nã: Breast cancer in the family does not, by itself, indicate BRCA1/2 testing. Per NCCN, testing is indicated when a close relative has: breast cancer at age 50 or younger, triple-negative, in a man, bilateral; ovarian or pancreatic cancer; metastatic or high-risk prostate cancer; or there are 3 or more breast and/or prostate cancers in the same branch of the family (maternal or paternal). If any of these applies, check the detail in the family history. Without them, do not test routinely; review the family history at every visit.

textos.Um parente de 1º grau com câncer colorre: One first-degree relative with colorectal cancer diagnosed at 60 or older: average-risk screening (colonoscopy every 10 years or annual fecal occult blood test), starting at age 40.
textos.A história familiar preenche critério pa: The family history meets criteria for genetic testing.
textos.Câncer de mama aos 50 anos ou antes em p: Breast cancer at age 50 or younger in a close relative.

textos.Câncer de ovário (epitelial) em parente: Ovarian (epithelial) cancer in a close relative, at any age.
textos.Câncer de pâncreas em parente de 1º grau: Pancreatic cancer in a first-degree relative, at any age.
textos.Câncer de próstata metastático ou de alt: Metastatic or high-risk prostate cancer in a first-degree relative.
textos.3 ou mais casos de câncer de mama e/ou d: 3 or more breast and/or prostate cancers in the same branch of the family (maternal or paternal).
textos.Câncer de mama bilateral, ou mama e ovár: Bilateral breast cancer, or breast and ovarian cancer, in the same family member.
Refer for genetic counseling. Ideally the relative with cancer is tested first; if that is not possible, test the patient with a panel that includes BRCA1, BRCA2 and PALB2.
textos.Ascendência associada a variantes fundad: Ancestry associated with BRCA1/2 founder variants: apply a familial risk tool and offer genetic counseling; testing may be considered even without cancer in the family.
textos.Marque o que se aplica (parentes de 1º o: Check what applies (first- or second-degree relatives): it decides whether genetic testing is indicated (NCCN).
textos.Bilateral, ou mama e ovário na mesma pes: Bilateral, or breast and ovarian cancer in the same person
textos.Define o início e o intervalo da colonos: It sets the start and interval of colonoscopy (USMSTF).
textos.Parente de 1º grau antes dos 60 anos, ou: First-degree relative before 60, or 2 or more first-degree relatives
textos.Marque o que se aplica: define se há ind: Check what applies: it decides whether genetic testing is indicated (NCCN).
textos.Câncer de mama na família, por si só, nã: Breast cancer in the family does not, by itself, indicate BRCA1/2 testing. Per NCCN, testing is indicated when a close relative has: breast cancer at age 50 or younger, triple-negative, in a man, bilateral; ovarian or pancreatic cancer; metastatic or high-risk prostate cancer; or there are 3 or more breast and/or prostate cancers in the same branch of the family (maternal or paternal). If any of these applies, check the detail in the family history. Without them, do not test routinely; review the family history at every visit.
textos.Opcional. Resultados recentes entram no: Optional. Recent results feed the cardiovascular risk calculation (PREVENT). Also enter each test already done and its date, by typing or attaching the lab report as a PDF: anything still within the guideline interval is not ordered again. The report is read and discarded; nothing is stored.

textos.Muda a frequência da proteinúria (ACR 20: Changes how often proteinuria is checked (ACR 2024).
textos.Muda a frequência do rastreio cardiometa: Changes how often cardiometabolic screening is done (AAD-NPF 2019).
textos.Mais de 10% da superfície corporal, ou c: More than 10% of body surface area, or a candidate for systemic treatment or phototherapy
textos.Acomete o cólon (1/3 ou mais do cólon): Involves the colon (1/3 or more of the colon)
textos.8 anos ou mais desde o início dos sintom: 8 years or more since symptom onset
textos.Acomete o intestino delgado ou já teve r: Involves the small bowel or previous ileal resection
textos.Colite além do reto (não só proctite): Colitis beyond the rectum (not proctitis only)
textos.Define o rastreio de carcinoma hepatocel: Sets hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance without cirrhosis (AASLD 2018).
textos.História familiar de carcinoma hepatocel: Family history of hepatocellular carcinoma, HIV or hepatitis D coinfection, Asian man ≥ 40 years, Asian woman ≥ 50 years or sub-Saharan African origin
textos.EULAR 2022 (risco CV no LES e outras DRM: EULAR 2022 (CV risk in SLE and other RMDs)
textos.Prova de função pulmonar completa com di: Full pulmonary function test with diffusing capacity (DLCO)
textos.Carga viral da hepatite B (HBV-DNA quant: Hepatitis B viral load (quantitative HBV DNA), plasma
textos.Carga viral da hepatite C (HCV-RNA quant: Hepatitis C viral load (quantitative HCV RNA), plasma
textos.Psoríase extensa ou com tratamento sistê: Extensive psoriasis or on systemic treatment
textos.Doença de Crohn há 8 anos ou mais: Crohn's disease for 8 years or more
textos.Retocolite ulcerativa há 8 anos ou mais: Ulcerative colitis for 8 years or more
textos.Após cirurgia bariátrica: rastreamento a: After bariatric surgery: annual screening for nutritional deficiencies (iron, B12, folate, vitamin D, calcium and PTH).
textos.Artrite inflamatória: risco cardiovascul: Inflammatory arthritis: increased cardiovascular risk. Assess risk (lipids, blood pressure, glucose and smoking) at least every 5 years and after a major treatment change, with lipids measured when the disease is stable or in remission.
textos.Asma: função pulmonar no diagnóstico, 3-: Asthma: lung function at diagnosis, 3-6 months after starting controller treatment and periodically thereafter, at least every 1-2 years.
textos.Com fator de risco para doença pulmonar: With risk factors for interstitial lung disease (smoking, male sex, older age, high-titre rheumatoid factor or anti-CCP, active disease), screen with pulmonary function tests with diffusing capacity (DLCO) and high-resolution chest CT. Rheumatoid arthritis is part of the FRAX calculation.
textos.Com fibrose avançada ou cirrose, a ultra: With advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis, ultrasound every 6 months continues even after cure. Without it, no routine liver follow-up is needed; repeat HCV RNA after a new exposure.
textos.Considerar alvo de pressão arterial < 13: Consider a blood pressure target < 130/80 mmHg. Hydroxychloroquine for all unless contraindicated, also for cardiovascular protection; eye examination according to antimalarial and corticosteroid use.
textos.Câncer com tratamento sistêmico: HBsAg,: Cancer with systemic treatment: HBsAg, total anti-HBc and anti-HBs before starting (risk of hepatitis B reactivation); if positive, antiviral prophylaxis or monitoring as appropriate.
textos.Doença celíaca: antitransglutaminase IgA: Celiac disease: anti-transglutaminase IgA at 6 and 12 months after diagnosis and annually thereafter (gluten-free diet adherence).
textos.Doença celíaca: revisão anual com hemogr: Celiac disease: annual review with blood count, ferritin, folate, B12, vitamin D and thyroid function (associated deficiencies and autoimmune thyroiditis).
textos.Doença falciforme: exame de fundo de olh: Sickle cell disease: dilated fundus examination every 1-2 years (sickle retinopathy).
textos.Doença falciforme: rastrear albuminúria: Sickle cell disease: screen for albuminuria and proteinuria annually (sickle nephropathy).
textos.Doença inflamatória intestinal em remiss: Inflammatory bowel disease in remission or mild: blood count, ferritin and CRP every 6-12 months for anaemia and iron deficiency (every 3 months with active disease).
textos.Endoscopia única de rastreio se refluxo: One-time screening endoscopy if chronic reflux and 3 or more factors: male sex, age over 50, white race, smoking, obesity, Barrett's esophagus or esophageal adenocarcinoma in a first-degree relative.
textos.Esclerose sistêmica: avaliação anual do: Systemic sclerosis: annual assessment of pulmonary arterial hypertension risk (echocardiogram, pulmonary function tests with diffusing capacity and NT-proBNP; DETECT algorithm if disease for more than 3 years, FVC ≥ 40% and DLCO < 60%).
textos.Esclerose sistêmica: rastrear doença pul: Systemic sclerosis: screen for interstitial lung disease with high-resolution CT and pulmonary function tests; with interstitial disease, pulmonary function every 3-6 months in the first year.
textos.Estadiar a fibrose (FIB-4 ou elastografi: Stage fibrosis (FIB-4 or elastography). Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance with ultrasound every 6 months in cirrhosis and, without cirrhosis, with a family history of HCC, HIV or hepatitis D coinfection, Asian man ≥ 40 years, Asian woman ≥ 50 years or sub-Saharan African origin.
textos.Exame da pele para melanoma em todos (e: Skin examination for melanoma in all (and for non-melanoma skin cancer on thiopurines); bone densitometry with risk factors (corticosteroids for 3 months or more, postmenopause, low weight); screen for depression and anxiety; stop smoking; vaccines before immunosuppressants.
textos.Exame de toda a pele anual por profissio: Annual full skin examination by a trained professional (much higher skin cancer risk) and the general-population cancer screenings.
textos.Fibrilação atrial: ecocardiograma transt: Atrial fibrillation: transthoracic echocardiogram to guide treatment (structural heart disease, ventricular function, left atrium).
textos.Fibrilação atrial: função tireoidiana, h: Atrial fibrillation: thyroid function, blood count, kidney function and electrolytes at the initial assessment and periodic reassessment (anticoagulation, rhythm and rate control).
textos.Gota: função renal para a dose do hipour: Gout: kidney function for urate-lowering therapy dosing and for choosing flare anti-inflammatory treatment.
textos.Rastrear e tratar hipertensão, diabetes,: Screen for and treat hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidaemia, obesity and kidney disease, common in gout. Avoid diuretics for hypertension when there is an alternative.
textos.Hepatite B crônica: ALT e HBV-DNA a cada: Chronic hepatitis B: ALT and HBV DNA every 6-12 months off treatment (every 3 months in the first year of follow-up or with abnormal ALT) and every 3-6 months on treatment.
textos.Hepatite B crônica: HBeAg e anti-HBe def: Chronic hepatitis B: HBeAg and anti-HBe define the phase of infection.
textos.Hepatite B crônica: testar coinfecção po: Chronic hepatitis B: test for HCV and HIV coinfection and hepatitis A immunity (vaccinate if susceptible). Anti-HDV if there are risk factors.
textos.Hepatite B: estadiamento e carcinoma hep: Hepatitis B: staging and hepatocellular carcinoma
textos.Hepatite B com alto risco de carcinoma h: Hepatitis B at high risk of hepatocellular carcinoma, even without cirrhosis: ultrasound every 6 months, with or without alpha-fetoprotein.
textos.Hepatite C: FIB-4 (idade, AST, ALT e pla: Hepatitis C: FIB-4 (age, AST, ALT and platelets) to stage fibrosis; FIB-4 > 3.25 indicates advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis. Blood count, liver function and creatinine before treatment.
textos.Hepatite C: HBsAg, anti-HBc e anti-HBs a: Hepatitis C: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs before direct-acting antivirals (risk of hepatitis B reactivation); vaccinate against hepatitis B if susceptible.
textos.Hepatite C: HCV-RNA confirma a viremia a: Hepatitis C: HCV RNA confirms viraemia before treatment and, 12 weeks after the end, the sustained virological response (cure).
textos.Hepatite C: testar HIV e imunidade contr: Hepatitis C: test for HIV and hepatitis A immunity (vaccinate if susceptible).
textos.Lúpus sem atividade: hemograma, VHS, PCR: Inactive lupus: blood count, ESR, CRP, albumin, creatinine and urinalysis every 6-12 months; more often with activity, damage or according to treatment.
textos.Lúpus sem nefrite conhecida: rastrear pr: Lupus without known nephritis: screen for proteinuria at least every 6-12 months and at every extrarenal flare.
textos.Nefrite lúpica: quantificar a proteinúri: Lupus nephritis: quantify proteinuria at least every 3 months until complete response and every 3-6 months in sustained complete response.
textos.Lúpus: anticorpos antifosfolípides na av: Lupus: antiphospholipid antibodies at the initial assessment and again before pregnancy, surgery, oestrogen or after a vascular event, if previously negative.
textos.Lúpus: complemento (C3, C4) e anti-DNA a: Lupus: complement (C3, C4) and anti-dsDNA help confirm activity or remission.
textos.Lúpus: lipídios e glicemia anuais, com p: Lupus: annual lipids and glucose, with blood pressure and BMI (cardiovascular risk).
textos.Lúpus: rastrear HIV e hepatites B e C (e: Lupus: screen for HIV and hepatitis B and C (and latent tuberculosis) before immunosuppressants.
textos.Osteoporose: investigar causas secundári: Osteoporosis: investigate secondary causes at diagnosis (calcium, phosphorus, kidney function, alkaline phosphatase and PTH) before starting treatment.
textos.Perguntar por dor ou rigidez articular e: Ask about joint pain or stiffness at every visit (psoriatic arthritis), screen for depression and anxiety and counsel on smoking and alcohol.
textos.Primeira colonoscopia de vigilância 8 an: First surveillance colonoscopy 8 years after symptom onset (right at diagnosis if there is primary sclerosing cholangitis) when there is Crohn's with 1/3 or more of the colon; the next interval depends on risk. Tick the item's details for the system to calculate.

First surveillance colonoscopy 8 years after symptom onset (right at diagnosis if there is primary sclerosing cholangitis) when there is colitis beyond the rectum; the next interval depends on risk. Tick the item's details for the system to calculate.
textos.Psoríase: dosar os lipídios e rastrear h: Psoriasis: measure lipids and screen for hypertension and diabetes as in the general population.

Psoriasis: measure lipids and screen for hypertension and diabetes as in the general population; earlier and more often in extensive psoriasis (> 10% of body surface area) or with an indication for systemic treatment or phototherapy.
textos.Psoríase extensa (> 10% da superfície co: Extensive psoriasis (> 10% of body surface area) or with an indication for systemic treatment or phototherapy: earlier and more frequent diabetes screening.
textos.Síndrome dos ovários policísticos: avali: Polycystic ovary syndrome: assess glycaemic status at diagnosis and every 1-3 years, whatever the BMI (OGTT preferred; fasting glucose or HbA1c as alternatives).
textos.Síndrome dos ovários policísticos: perfi: Polycystic ovary syndrome: lipid profile at diagnosis; thereafter, according to cardiovascular risk.
textos.O item antigo reunia doenças com acompan: The old item grouped diseases with different follow-up. Choose the disease from the list (rheumatoid arthritis, lupus, psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, spondyloarthritis, Crohn's, ulcerative colitis or systemic sclerosis).
textos.Crohn de intestino delgado ou ressecção: Small-bowel Crohn's or ileal resection: vitamin B12 and folic acid at least once a year.
textos.Doença de Crohn (Crohn com 1/3 ou mais d: Crohn's disease (Crohn's with 1/3 or more of the colon) for 8 years or more: surveillance colonoscopy with chromoendoscopy; the next one in 1, 3 or 5 years according to risk (inflammation, previous dysplasia, stricture, pseudopolyps, colorectal cancer in a first-degree relative).
textos.Retocolite ulcerativa (colite além do re: Ulcerative colitis (colitis beyond the rectum) for 8 years or more: surveillance colonoscopy with chromoendoscopy; the next one in 1, 3 or 5 years according to risk (inflammation, previous dysplasia, stricture, pseudopolyps, colorectal cancer in a first-degree relative).
textos.Doença de Crohn com colangite esclerosan: Crohn's disease with primary sclerosing cholangitis: annual surveillance colonoscopy from the diagnosis of cholangitis, with chromoendoscopy.
textos.Retocolite ulcerativa com colangite escl: Ulcerative colitis with primary sclerosing cholangitis: annual surveillance colonoscopy from the diagnosis of cholangitis, with chromoendoscopy.
textos.Doença do refluxo crônica com 3 ou mais: Chronic reflux disease with 3 or more risk factors for Barrett's esophagus (male sex, age over 50, smoking, obesity): one-time screening endoscopy.
textos.Antraciclina ou terapia anti-HER2: ecoca: Anthracycline or anti-HER2 therapy: echocardiogram (with strain if available) and ECG before starting; on anti-HER2 therapy, echocardiogram every 3 months during treatment and 12 months after the end.
textos.Antraciclina ou terapia anti-HER2: tropo: Anthracycline or anti-HER2 therapy: baseline troponin and natriuretic peptide to stratify cardiotoxicity risk and compare during follow-up.
textos.Terapia anti-HER2: ecocardiograma a cada: Anti-HER2 therapy: echocardiogram every 3 months during treatment.
textos.Bloqueio androgênico: pressão arterial,: Androgen deprivation: blood pressure, lipid profile and glucose before starting (insulin resistance, dyslipidaemia and cardiovascular risk).
textos.Bloqueio hormonal com agonista ou antago: Hormonal suppression with a GnRH agonist or antagonist: bone densitometry at the start and periodically (accelerated bone loss from low sex hormones).
textos.Com 65 anos ou mais, tabagismo atual ou: At 65 years or older, current or long-term past smoking, or other cardiovascular or cancer risk factors, use only if there is no suitable alternative; caution with venous thrombosis risk. Inactivated herpes zoster vaccine before or during use.
textos.Fluoruracila ou capecitabina: testar def: Fluorouracil or capecitabine: test for DPD deficiency (DPYD genotyping or plasma uracil) before starting; complete deficiency contraindicates, partial deficiency calls for a lower starting dose.
textos.Imunobiológico ou inibidor de JAK: rastr: Biologic or JAK inhibitor: screen for hepatitis C before treatment; if HCV RNA positive, refer for antiviral treatment.
textos.Inibidor de JAK: enzimas hepáticas de ro: JAK inhibitor: routine liver enzymes during use.
textos.Inibidor de JAK: neutrófilos, linfócitos: JAK inhibitor: neutrophils, lymphocytes and haemoglobin at baseline, after 4-8 weeks and every 3 months thereafter.
textos.Inibidor de JAK: perfil lipídico 4-8 sem: JAK inhibitor: lipid profile 4-8 weeks after starting (LDL and HDL rise) and then according to cardiovascular risk.
textos.Inibidor de checkpoint: ECG, troponina e: Checkpoint inhibitor: ECG, troponin and natriuretic peptide before starting (immune-mediated myocarditis).
textos.Inibidor de checkpoint: TSH, T4 livre e: Checkpoint inhibitor: TSH, free T4 and glucose at baseline and every 4-6 weeks during treatment (thyroiditis, hypophysitis, immune-mediated diabetes).
textos.Rituximabe: IgG antes do primeiro ciclo: Rituximab: IgG before the first cycle and before each new cycle (hypogammaglobulinaemia increases the risk of serious infection).
textos.Tocilizumabe: neutrófilos, plaquetas e t: Tocilizumab: neutrophils, platelets and transaminases at baseline, 4-8 weeks later (transaminases every 4-8 weeks in the first 6 months) and every 3 months thereafter.
textos.Tocilizumabe: perfil lipídico 4-8 semana: Tocilizumab: lipid profile 4-8 weeks after starting.
textos.Tratamento sistêmico do câncer: HBsAg, a: Systemic cancer treatment: HBsAg, total anti-HBc and anti-HBs before starting (risk of hepatitis B reactivation).
