textos.3 classes de anti-hipertensivos: é HAS r: 3 antihypertensive classes: this is resistant hypertension if BP is above target (≥ 130/80) on maximally tolerated doses with confirmed adherence. Enter the BP or check "Resistant hypertension" if that is the case.
textos.No início e a cada ajuste de dose: At the start and at each dose adjustment
textos.Diabéticos sem estatina, menos de 40 ano: Diabetics not on a statin, under 40 years
textos.Diabetes tipo 1 com obesidade ou MASLD: Type 1 diabetes with obesity or MASLD
textos.Obesidade com fator de risco metabólico: Obesity with a metabolic risk factor
textos.Transplante em uso de sirolimo ou everol: Transplant recipient on sirolimus or everolimus
textos.Sirolimo ou everolimo, sangue total (nív: Sirolimus or everolimus, whole blood (trough level)
textos.Aferir a pressão arterial em cada consul: Measure blood pressure at every visit during use (corticosteroid-induced hypertension).
textos.Corticoide sistêmico por 3 meses ou mais: Systemic corticosteroid for 3 months or more: keep vitamin D adequate (prevention of corticosteroid-induced osteoporosis).
textos.Vitamina D no corticoide crônico: diretr: Vitamin D with chronic corticosteroids: guidelines differ
textos.O motor pede a 25(OH)D basal no uso de c: The engine orders baseline 25(OH)D with corticosteroid use for 3 months or more (Sparling 2024). ACR 2022 recommends optimizing calcium and vitamin D without requiring measurement, and the Endocrine Society 2024 suggests against routine testing in adults without an indication. Remove the test if you will supplement empirically.
textos.Sem dose e duração, o uso foi tratado co: Without dose and duration, use was treated as chronic (≥ 3 months). With both, the tool tells whether there is immunosuppression (live-virus vaccines) and whether densitometry, a baseline laboratory panel and a tuberculin test apply (they are dropped with a low, short course). Glucose, lipids, blood pressure and eyes apply at any dose.
textos.A SBC 2025 inclui o ácido úrico nos exam: SBC 2025 includes uric acid among the routine tests for people with hypertension; AHA/ACC treats it as an optional test, without serial repetition. The engine orders one measurement at the initial evaluation.
textos.Ácido úrico na hipertensão: diretrizes d: Uric acid in hypertension: guidelines differ
textos.Avaliação inicial do hipertenso: a SBC 2: Initial evaluation of hypertension: SBC 2025 includes it in the routine; in AHA/ACC it is an optional, non-serial test.
textos.Análise de urina na avaliação inicial do: Urinalysis at the initial evaluation of hypertension (kidney damage and secondary hypertension).
textos.Hipertensão: exames básicos da avaliação: Hypertension: basic tests of the initial evaluation (glucose, complete blood count, lipids, creatinine with eGFR, sodium, potassium, calcium, TSH, urinalysis and ECG).
textos.O motor pede a relação aldosterona/renin: The engine orders the aldosterone/renin ratio in resistant hypertension (AHA/ACC 2025, class 1, at any potassium) and in hypertension with sleep apnea (Endocrine Society 2016). Also screen with spontaneous or diuretic-induced hypokalemia, adrenal incidentaloma, persistent BP ≥ 150/100 or a family history of hypertension or stroke before age 40. The Endocrine Society 2025 suggests screening everyone with hypertension (conditional recommendation, low certainty).
textos.Hipertensão com apneia obstrutiva do son: Hypertension with obstructive sleep apnea: screen for primary aldosteronism (morning aldosterone/renin ratio; keep potassium normal and stop the mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist beforehand).
textos.Antes de iniciar, testar o HLA-B*58:01 e: Before starting, test HLA-B*58:01 in people of Southeast Asian or African descent (higher risk of severe skin reaction); conditional recommendation. Start at a low dose (up to 100 mg/day; less in kidney disease) and titrate to the uric acid target.
textos.Amiodarona: TSH e T4 livre antes de inic: Amiodarone: TSH and free T4 before starting and every 6 months (hypo- and hyperthyroidism).
textos.Amiodarona: prova de função pulmonar com: Amiodarone: pulmonary function test with DLCO before starting (baseline for new cough or dyspnea).
textos.Amiodarona: radiografia de tórax antes d: Amiodarone: chest X-ray before starting and yearly (pulmonary toxicity).
textos.A amiodarona potencializa a varfarina: r: Amiodarone potentiates warfarin: empirically reduce the warfarin dose when starting amiodarone and check the INR weekly for the first 6-8 weeks.
textos.Antagonista mineralocorticoide (e sacubi: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (and sacubitril/valsartan in heart failure): potassium and creatinine 1 and 4 weeks after starting or adjusting the dose, then monthly up to 3 months and then every 3-4 months.
textos.Anticoagulante oral direto: hemoglobina: Direct oral anticoagulant: hemoglobin and liver function yearly (every 6 months at 75 years or older or with frailty).
textos.Anticoagulante oral direto: função renal: Direct oral anticoagulant: kidney function (CrCl by Cockcroft-Gault) to adjust the dose: yearly; every 6 months at 75 years or older or with frailty; with CrCl ≤ 60 mL/min, every "CrCl/10" months (CrCl of 40: every 4 months).
textos.Carbamazepina, fenitoína e fenobarbital: Carbamazepine, phenytoin and phenobarbital reduce the efficacy of oral hormonal contraceptives, the patch, the ring and the implant: prefer an IUD (copper or levonorgestrel) or the 3-monthly injectable.
textos.Valproato em mulher que pode engravidar: Valproate in a woman who can become pregnant
textos.Programa de prevenção da gravidez: teste: Pregnancy prevention programme: pregnancy test before starting and when needed, effective contraception throughout use and yearly specialist review of the indication (risk of malformations and neurodevelopmental disorders).
textos.Hemograma com diferencial se houver febr: Complete blood count with differential if there is fever or sore throat, and liver function if there are symptoms of hepatotoxicity; withhold the antithyroid drug until the result. Baseline blood count and liver function before starting.
textos.Hipertireoidismo: T4 livre e T3 total (c: Hyperthyroidism: free T4 and total T3 (with TSH, which may stay suppressed for months) 4-6 weeks after starting the antithyroid drug, then every 4-8 weeks until euthyroid and then every 2-3 months.
textos.Hipertireoidismo: hemograma com diferenc: Hyperthyroidism: baseline complete blood count with differential and liver function before starting the antithyroid drug (pre-existing neutropenia or liver disease changes the choice).
textos.As causas secundárias (cálcio, fósforo,: Secondary causes (calcium, phosphorus, kidney function, alkaline phosphatase and PTH) are investigated at diagnosis, before starting treatment. If they have not been investigated yet, check the "recent diagnosis" detail of the item.
textos.Avaliação completa dos pés pelo menos um: Comprehensive foot evaluation at least once a year: inspection, pedal pulses, 10-g monofilament and one more sensory test (vibration with a 128-Hz tuning fork, pinprick or ankle reflex); at every visit if there is loss of sensation, deformity or prior ulcer.
textos.Azatioprina: atividade da TPMT (ou genot: Azathioprine: TPMT activity (or TPMT and NUDT15 genotyping) before starting; low activity calls for a reduced dose and absent activity contraindicates it.
textos.Capacidade funcional e tolerância ao exe: Functional capacity and exercise tolerance; useful for pulmonary rehabilitation and prognosis.
textos.Clozapina: contagem absoluta de neutrófi: Clozapine: absolute neutrophil count before starting, weekly for the first 6 months, every 2 weeks from month 6 to 12 and monthly thereafter (FDA label; the FDA removed the REMS in 2025 but kept the recommendation). The Brazilian label asks for weekly counts for the first 18 weeks and monthly thereafter.
textos.O motor seguiu a bula americana para os: The engine followed the US label for neutrophils (weekly up to 6 months, every 2 weeks up to 12 months and monthly thereafter); the Brazilian label asks for weekly up to 18 weeks and monthly thereafter. Myocarditis: troponin and CRP before starting and on days 7, 14, 21 and 28; troponin above twice the upper limit or CRP above 100 mg/L call for stopping.
textos.DRC G3a ou mais: potássio e bicarbonato: CKD G3a or worse: potassium and bicarbonate together with eGFR (hyperkalemia and metabolic acidosis, which change treatment).
textos.DRC: rastrear anemia (hemoglobina) pelo: CKD: screen for anemia (hemoglobin) at least once a year in G3 and twice a year in G4-G5.
textos.Distúrbio mineral e ósseo da DRC: 25(OH): CKD mineral and bone disorder: baseline 25(OH)D from G3a; repeat according to the value and treatment.
textos.Distúrbio mineral e ósseo da DRC: PTH ba: CKD mineral and bone disorder: baseline PTH in G3 (repeat according to the value and progression), every 6-12 months in G4 and every 3-6 months in G5.
textos.Distúrbio mineral e ósseo da DRC: cálcio: CKD mineral and bone disorder: calcium and phosphorus every 6-12 months in G3, every 3-6 months in G4 and every 1-3 months in G5.
textos.Distúrbio mineral e ósseo da DRC: fosfat: CKD mineral and bone disorder: baseline alkaline phosphatase in G3 and yearly from G4 (more often with elevated PTH).
textos.Doença renal crônica: TFG estimada (CKD-: Chronic kidney disease: estimated GFR (CKD-EPI 2021) and albuminuria (uACR) at least once a year and more often with higher risk of progression, by the KDIGO 2024 G x A heat map (from once a year in G1-G2/A1 to 4 or more times in G4-G5). The uACR also defines the A category and the indication for SGLT2 inhibitors and ACE inhibitors or ARBs.
textos.Doença renal crônica: encaminhar ao nefr: Chronic kidney disease: refer to nephrology
textos.TFG abaixo de 30 mL/min/1,73 m² ou album: eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m² or A3 albuminuria (uACR ≥ 300 mg/g): shared follow-up with nephrology.
textos.Doença renal crônica: informe o estágio: Chronic kidney disease: enter the stage
textos.A frequência de TFG e albuminúria depend: The frequency of eGFR and albuminuria depends on the G stage (eGFR) and the A category (albuminuria). Enter the creatinine and check the item details for the system to adjust it; without them, the minimum is once a year.
textos.Denosumabe: cálcio antes de cada dose e,: Denosumab: calcium before each dose and, with risk of hypocalcemia (advanced chronic kidney disease), also within 2 weeks after the first dose.
textos.Ácido zoledrônico: creatinina (clearance: Zoledronic acid: creatinine (clearance) and calcium before each infusion; hypocalcemia must be corrected first, and CrCl < 35 mL/min contraindicates it.
textos.Diabetes sem estatina: perfil lipídico n: Diabetes not on a statin: lipid panel at diagnosis and at the initial evaluation; then yearly from age 40 (when a statin becomes indicated) and every 5 years before that.
textos.Diabetes tipo 1: rastrear doença celíaca: Type 1 diabetes: screen for celiac disease (tissue transglutaminase IgA with total IgA) soon after diagnosis; repeat if there are symptoms, unstable growth or glucose, or a first-degree relative with celiac disease.
textos.Diabetes: hemograma com plaquetas na ava: Diabetes: complete blood count with platelets at the yearly evaluation (platelets for FIB-4; anemia from kidney disease and from B12 deficiency with metformin).
textos.Rastreio de fibrose hepática pelo FIB-4: Liver fibrosis screening with FIB-4 (age, AST, ALT and platelets), even with normal enzymes: below 1.3, repeat in 1-2 years; from 1.3 up, elastography; above 2.67, refer to hepatology.
textos.Rastreamento de retinopatia diabética co: Diabetic retinopathy screening with a dilated fundus exam: yearly; every 1-2 years if there is no retinopathy on one or more exams and glucose is controlled. In type 1, the first exam within 5 years of diagnosis; in type 2, at diagnosis.
textos.Em tratamento hipolipemiante: perfil lip: On lipid-lowering treatment: lipid panel 4-12 weeks after starting or adjusting the dose (adherence and response) and then every 3-12 months. Without treatment, measure to decide on starting.

On lipid-lowering treatment: lipid panel 4-12 weeks after starting or adjusting the dose (adherence and response) and then every 3-12 months. Without treatment, measure to decide on starting. Atherosclerotic CVD: very high risk by SBC 2025, LDL-C target < 50 mg/dL (< 40 mg/dL at extreme risk).
textos.Perfil lipídico no diabetes em uso de es: Lipid panel in diabetes on a statin: guidelines differ
textos.O motor seguiu a ACC/AHA 2018 (4-12 sema: The engine followed ACC/AHA 2018 (4-12 weeks after starting or adjusting and then every 3-12 months). ADA 2026 accepts, after the 4-12-week check, one lipid panel per year.
textos.Eosinófilos no sangue para decidir o cor: Blood eosinophils to decide on inhaled corticosteroids (≥ 300/µL favors; < 100/µL argues against) and anemia or polycythemia, which change dyspnea.
textos.Espirometria pós-broncodilatador para co: Post-bronchodilator spirometry to confirm the diagnosis and follow progression, at least once a year.
textos.Indicada se a saturação de O2 em repouso: Indicated if resting O2 saturation is ≤ 92% or in severe COPD, to assess hypoxemia and hypercapnia and to indicate oxygen therapy.
textos.Não confirma a DPOC, mas afasta diagnóst: It does not confirm COPD, but rules out alternative diagnoses and comorbidities (bronchiectasis, cancer, heart failure).
textos.Toda pessoa com DPOC deve dosar a alfa-1: Everyone with COPD should have alpha-1 antitrypsin measured once (WHO recommendation adopted by GOLD); a low level calls for genotyping and family screening.
textos.Fingolimode: ECG antes da primeira dose: Fingolimod: ECG before the first dose and 6-hour monitoring at the first dose (bradycardia and atrioventricular block).
textos.Fingolimode: exame oftalmológico 3-4 mes: Fingolimod: eye exam 3-4 months after starting (macular edema); before starting in diabetes or with uveitis.
textos.Fingolimode: hemograma (linfócitos) ante: Fingolimod: complete blood count (lymphocytes) before starting, at month 3 and at least yearly.
textos.Fingolimode: sorologia para varicela-zós: Fingolimod: varicella-zoster serology before starting; if not immune, vaccinate and start fingolimod only 1 month later.
textos.Fingolimode: transaminases antes de inic: Fingolimod: transaminases before starting, at months 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 and periodically thereafter.
textos.Insuficiência cardíaca: TSH na avaliação: Heart failure: TSH at the initial evaluation (hypo- and hyperthyroidism cause or worsen HF).
textos.Insuficiência cardíaca: peptídeo natriur: Heart failure: natriuretic peptide at the initial evaluation (prognosis and baseline) and again when the clinical picture changes.
textos.Insuficiência cardíaca: rastrear anemia: Heart failure: periodically screen everyone for anemia and iron deficiency with complete blood count, ferritin and transferrin saturation (class I). Iron deficiency: ferritin < 100 ng/mL, or 100-299 with saturation < 20%; with symptoms and reduced or mildly reduced ejection fraction, intravenous iron (class I).
textos.Metotrexato: radiografia de tórax antes: Methotrexate: chest X-ray before starting, if none in the last 6 months (baseline for pneumonitis).
textos.Micofenolato: hemograma semanal no 1º mê: Mycophenolate: complete blood count weekly in month 1, every 2 weeks in months 2 and 3 and monthly until 1 year (neutropenia).
textos.Natalizumabe: anticorpo anti-JCV (com ín: Natalizumab: anti-JCV antibody (with index) before starting to stratify the risk of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML), and every 6 months while negative or with a low index.
textos.Natalizumabe: função hepática periódica: Natalizumab: periodic liver function (liver injury described in the label).
textos.Ocrelizumabe: imunoglobulinas antes de i: Ocrelizumab: immunoglobulins before starting and before each new dose (hypogammaglobulinemia raises the risk of serious infection). Active hepatitis B contraindicates use: HBsAg and anti-HBc before the first dose.
textos.O motor seguiu o PCDT do MS para todo te: The engine followed the Brazilian MoH guideline for all tenofovir (creatinine and urinalysis every 3-6 months). HIVMA/IDSA accepts longer intervals with tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), which is less nephrotoxic than the fumarate (TDF).
textos.PrEP em quem pode engravidar: teste de g: PrEP in people who can become pregnant: pregnancy test every 120 days or when needed.
textos.PrEP: HBsAg e anti-HBs anuais, conforme: PrEP: HBsAg and anti-HBs yearly, according to the initial assessment; vaccinate those who are not immune.
textos.PrEP: anti-HCV a cada 120 dias se o ante: PrEP: anti-HCV every 120 days if the previous one was non-reactive (the guideline text says every 3 months).
textos.PrEP: teste de HIV (de preferência teste: PrEP: HIV test (preferably a rapid test) 30 days after starting and at every visit, every 120 days; required to dispense the medication.
textos.PrEP: teste molecular para clamídia e go: PrEP: molecular test for chlamydia and gonorrhea every 6 months (earlier if there are symptoms).
textos.PrEP: creatinina com clearance a cada 12: PrEP: creatinine with clearance every 12 months under age 50, without comorbidity and with CrCl ≥ 90 mL/min; every 6 months from age 50, with hypertension, diabetes or CrCl < 90 (or without a calculated CrCl).
textos.Sirolimo ou everolimo: lipídios, glicemi: Sirolimus or everolimus: periodic lipids, glucose and proteinuria (dyslipidemia, hyperglycemia and proteinuria induced by the mTOR inhibitor).
textos.Transplantado em uso de sirolimo ou ever: Transplant recipient on sirolimus or everolimus: trough level, with the target set by the transplant team; repeat after a change in an interacting medication.
textos.Testosterona: hematócrito antes de inici: Testosterone: hematocrit before starting, 3-6 months after starting and yearly thereafter; above 54%, stop until it normalizes and investigate.
textos.Testosterona: PSA 3-12 meses após o iníc: Testosterone: PSA 3-12 months after starting (men aged 55 to 69, or 40 to 69 at increased risk of prostate cancer) and then according to usual screening.
textos.Mesalazina: função renal antes de inicia: Mesalamine: kidney function before starting and at least once a year (interstitial nephritis).
textos.Sotalol: ECG com QTc no início e a cada: Sotalol: ECG with QTc at the start and at each dose adjustment (proarrhythmic).
textos.Sotalol: função renal (ClCr) para defini: Sotalol: kidney function (CrCl) to set the dose and interval; renal elimination.
textos.Define a frequência de TFG, albuminúria: Sets the frequency of eGFR, albuminuria and the tests from G3a on (KDIGO 2024). With creatinine entered, the G stage is calculated.
textos.TFG ≥ 60 (G1-G2, com albuminúria ou lesã: eGFR ≥ 60 (G1-G2, with albuminuria or kidney damage)
textos.Define a investigação de causas secundár: Sets the investigation of secondary causes (BHOF 2022).
textos.Diagnóstico recente, causas secundárias: Recent diagnosis, secondary causes not yet investigated
textos.Após 4 semanas da primeira carga viral d: 4 weeks after the first detectable viral load
textos.Em cada consulta, no máximo mensal: At every visit, at most monthly
textos.HIV: carga viral detectável em TARV: HIV: detectable viral load on ART
textos.Diabetes tipo 1: quando começar a uACR: Type 1 diabetes: when to start uACR
textos.Em TARV, assintomático e com carga viral: On ART, asymptomatic and with undetectable viral load: below 350 every 6 months; 350-500 yearly; above 500, repeat in 6 months, and with 2 consecutive tests above 500 (6 months apart) it is no longer needed. Off ART, clinical event or virologic failure: every 6 months. On prophylaxis or with an opportunistic infection: every 3 months.
textos.Doença do refluxo crônica com 3 ou mais: Chronic reflux disease with 3 or more risk factors for Barrett's esophagus (male sex, age over 50, white race, smoking, obesity, Barrett's or esophageal adenocarcinoma in a first-degree relative): one-time screening endoscopy.
textos.Endoscopia única de rastreio se refluxo: One-time screening endoscopy if chronic reflux and 3 or more factors: male sex, age over 50, white race, smoking, obesity, Barrett's esophagus or esophageal adenocarcinoma in a first-degree relative. Race is not collected: with 2 factors and white race, endoscopy is indicated.
textos.Dose até 5 mg/kg/dia de peso real (menos: Dose up to 5 mg/kg/day of actual body weight (under 400 mg/day in severe obesity). Baseline exam soon after starting, with fundus exam, OCT and wide-pattern fundus autofluorescence. Yearly screening with OCT and autofluorescence; it may be deferred during the first 5 years without risk factors (kidney disease, tamoxifen, starting at an older age).
textos.Com doença renal crônica ou tamoxifeno:: With chronic kidney disease or tamoxifen: yearly screening from the start.
textos.Hepatite B com HIV: vigilância de carcin: Hepatitis B with HIV: hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance with ultrasound every 6 months (with or without alpha-fetoprotein) in men from age 18 and women from age 40, even without cirrhosis; conditional recommendation.
textos.Hepatite B crônica: anti-HDV em toda pes: Chronic hepatitis B: anti-HDV in everyone with a reactive HBsAg; if reactive, order HDV RNA (hepatitis delta accelerates fibrosis and hepatocellular carcinoma).
textos.Hepatite B crônica: testar coinfecção po: Chronic hepatitis B: test for HCV and HIV coinfection and hepatitis A immunity (vaccinate if susceptible).
textos.Nefrite lúpica: complemento (C3, C4) e a: Lupus nephritis: complement (C3, C4) and anti-dsDNA at every follow-up visit, no more than once a month.
textos.No tipo 1, a uACR e a TFG anuais começam: In type 1, yearly uACR and eGFR start 5 years after diagnosis (in type 2, from diagnosis). The engine does not know the duration of diabetes: remove the uACR if the diagnosis is less than 5 years old and there is no other indication.
textos.Rastreamento de hiperaldosteronismo prim: Screening for primary aldosteronism, an important cause of resistant hypertension. Aldosterone and renin (activity or concentration) with serum potassium, drawn in the morning, seated and without prolonged tourniquet; correct hypokalemia first. It can be done on most antihypertensives; beta-blockers and central alpha-2 agonists may give false positives. Interpret by the cutoffs of the laboratory's method (immunoassay or mass spectrometry; renin activity or concentration): suppressed renin with elevated aldosterone.
textos.Hipertensão com apneia obstrutiva do son: Hypertension with obstructive sleep apnea: screen for primary aldosteronism (aldosterone and renin with potassium, in the morning and seated; correct hypokalemia; interpret by the cutoffs of the laboratory's method).
textos.Rastreio de fibrose hepática pelo FIB-4: Liver fibrosis screening with FIB-4 (age, AST, ALT and platelets), even with normal enzymes: under age 35 FIB-4 is unreliable: interpret it together with elastography. Below 1.3, repeat in 1-2 years; from 1.3 up, elastography; above 2.67, refer to hepatology.

Liver fibrosis screening with FIB-4 (age, AST, ALT and platelets), even with normal enzymes: at 65 years or older, below 2.0 rules out advanced fibrosis and is repeated in 1-2 years; from 2.0 to 2.67, elastography; above 2.67, refer to hepatology.
textos.Uma carga viral detectável não define fa: A single detectable viral load does not define failure: reinforce adherence, review interactions and repeat the viral load 4 weeks later. Confirmed failure (two consecutive detectable loads, the last above 500 copies/mL): order genotyping (add it from the catalog). Between 200 and 500 copies/mL, the test is not available in the SUS: viral load every 3 months.
textos.Sem dose e duração, o uso foi tratado co: Without dose and duration, use was treated as chronic (≥ 3 months). With both, the tool tells whether there is immunosuppression (live-virus vaccines) and whether densitometry applies. Laboratory assessment and corticosteroid monitoring apply at any dose.
textos.Rastreamento de pré-diabetes e diabetes: Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. One test is enough: HbA1c or, as an alternative, fasting plasma glucose. HbA1c < 5.7% normal, 5.7-6.4% prediabetes, ≥ 6.5% diabetes (glucose: < 100, 100-125 and ≥ 126 mg/dL). Repeat every 3 years if normal and yearly in prediabetes.
textos.IMC ≥25 com fator de risco para diabetes: BMI ≥25 with a risk factor for diabetes
textos.Painel lipídico (não jejum). A partir do: Lipid panel (non-fasting). From age 76, without established cardiovascular disease, order according to life expectancy and only if the result would change management (starting or continuing a statin).
textos.Medição única na vida adulta para refina: Single measurement in adulthood to refine cardiovascular risk, if never measured. Prefer an isoform-independent assay.
textos.Creatinina com TFG estimada (CKD-EPI 202: Creatinine with estimated GFR (CKD-EPI 2021), together with albuminuria, in people with a risk factor for chronic kidney disease.
textos.Albuminúria (relação albumina/creatinina: Albuminuria (urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio in a spot sample), together with estimated GFR, in people with a risk factor for chronic kidney disease.
textos.Adultos com fator de risco para DRC (HAS: Adults with a risk factor for CKD (hypertension, CVD, heart failure, family history of kidney disease)
textos.Rastreamento de HIV: pelo menos um teste: HIV screening: at least one test in a lifetime between ages 15 and 65, regardless of risk; repeat in people at increased risk (key populations, multiple partners, STIs, PrEP use).
textos.Teste para detecção de Hepatite C: todas: Hepatitis C test: everyone aged 18 or older at least once; offer more actively from age 40.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B com o painel: Hepatitis B screening with the triple panel, once, in adults without a documented complete vaccine series (3 doses). Reactive anti-HBs without HBsAg and anti-HBc: immune, no vaccine needed. Whole panel non-reactive: susceptible, vaccinate. Reactive HBsAg or anti-HBc: investigate infection. Repeat if there is a risk factor (USPSTF 2020).
textos.Uso de PrEP: teste de HIV a cada retorno: PrEP use: HIV test at every follow-up visit, at the interval set by the service's PrEP protocol.
textos.Uso de PrEP é risco aumentado de IST: of: PrEP use means increased STI risk: offer a syphilis test together with the HIV test, at the interval set by the service's PrEP protocol.
textos.Creatinina com TFG estimada (CKD-EPI 202: Creatinine with estimated GFR (CKD-EPI 2021) at the initial assessment and during follow-up of hypertension.
textos.Glicemia de jejum e HbA1c fazem parte do: Fasting glucose and HbA1c are part of the routine tests in the assessment of a person with hypertension.
textos.ECG de 12 derivações na avaliação inicia: 12-lead ECG at the initial assessment and during follow-up of hypertension (left ventricular hypertrophy, arrhythmias, ischemia).
textos.HAS estabelecida: MAPA de 24 h ou, como: Established hypertension: 24-h ABPM or, as an alternative, HBPM (7 days) to assess control, the white-coat effect and masked hypertension.
textos.Adultos com HAS (avaliar controle, avent: Adults with hypertension (assess control, white-coat effect or masked hypertension)
textos.HAS resistente: avaliação de hipertrofia: Resistant hypertension: assessment of left ventricular hypertrophy, diastolic function and target organ damage.
textos.PA de consultório alterada sem diagnósti: Elevated office BP without a diagnosis of hypertension: confirm out of the office with 24-h ABPM or, as an alternative, HBPM (7 days), and repeat the BP at another visit. Investigate target organ damage (hypertension work-up) only after confirmation.
textos.PA de consultório alterada, HAS a confir: Elevated office BP, hypertension to be confirmed
textos.Rastreamento de osteoporose para preveni: Osteoporosis screening to prevent fragility fractures. Women ≥65 years. The USPSTF sets no interval: repeat according to the T-score and risk (BHOF).
textos.Mulher pós-menopausa com menos de 65 ano: Postmenopausal woman under 65 with a risk factor for fracture: calculate FRAX (Brazil) and order bone densitometry if the risk is elevated. Confirm that the patient is postmenopausal.
textos.Pós-menopausa <65 anos com fator de risc: Postmenopausal <65 years with a risk factor
textos.Rastreamento de aneurisma de aorta abdom: Abdominal aortic aneurysm screening: one ultrasound in men aged 65 to 75 who have ever smoked (100 or more cigarettes in a lifetime), whatever the pack-years.
textos.Homens 65-75 anos que já fumaram: Men 65-75 years who have ever smoked
textos.Diabetes em uso de estatina: perfil lipí: Diabetes on a statin: lipid panel 4-12 weeks after starting or adjusting the dose and then yearly.
textos.Diabéticos em uso de estatina: People with diabetes on a statin
textos.Diabetes: perfil lipídico no diagnóstico: Diabetes: lipid panel at diagnosis and at the initial assessment; without a statin and under 40, every 5 years. When starting or adjusting a statin, repeat in 4-12 weeks and then yearly.
textos.Avaliação da função renal em pacientes d: Kidney function assessment in people with diabetes (estimated GFR with uACR). Perform yearly for early detection of diabetic kidney disease.
textos.Medir a PA em todo adulto: anualmente a: Measure BP in every adult: yearly from age 40 or with a risk factor (BP 130-139/85-89 mmHg, overweight or obesity, Black people); every 3-5 years from 18 to 39 with normal BP and no risk factor. Confirm out of the office before starting treatment.
textos.PA alterada: confirmar antes de rotular: Elevated BP: confirm before labeling hypertension
textos.Uma medida de consultório não confirma H: A single office reading does not confirm hypertension. Repeat the BP at another visit and confirm with HBPM or ABPM; target organ damage tests (potassium, creatinine, urinalysis, albuminuria, ECG) come after confirmation.
textos.Com PA de 130-139/80-89 mmHg, o motor se: With BP of 130-139/80-89 mmHg, the engine follows AHA/ACC 2025 (stage 1 hypertension, to be confirmed with HBPM or ABPM). SBC 2025 calls this range prehypertension and only considers hypertension from 140/90 mmHg.
textos.O motor segue a AHA/ACC 2025: ecocardiog: The engine follows AHA/ACC 2025: echocardiogram only when indicated (ECG with left ventricular strain, suspected heart failure, hard-to-control hypertension). SBC 2025 includes the echocardiogram in the assessment of cardiac target organ damage.
textos.Sem HAS, o motor não pede ECG ao diabéti: Without hypertension, the engine does not order an ECG for an asymptomatic person with diabetes (ADA 2026: do not screen for coronary disease in asymptomatic people). ACCF/AHA 2010 considers a baseline ECG reasonable (IIa): order it if the physician chooses to.
textos.Divergência entre diretrizes: rastreio d: Guideline divergence: diabetes screening without overweight
textos.O motor segue a ADA 2026 (rastreio a par: The engine follows ADA 2026 (screening from age 35, whatever the weight). USPSTF 2021 restricts screening at ages 35 to 70 to people with overweight or obesity.
textos.Divergência entre diretrizes: rastreio d: Guideline divergence: diabetes screening after age 70
textos.Acima de 70 anos o motor só rastreia com: Above age 70 the engine only screens with BMI ≥ 25 and a risk factor (USPSTF 2021: screening from 35 to 70). ADA 2026 has no stopping age: consider it if life expectancy justifies it.
textos.Até 30 anos o motor segue o PCDT-IST 202: Up to age 30 the engine follows PCDT-IST 2022 (yearly test). USPSTF 2019 asks for at least one test between 15 and 65 and repeat testing only with increased risk.
textos.Sem teste anterior, oferecer o anti-HIV: Without a previous test, offer anti-HIV testing if there is risk (new partners, STIs). USPSTF 2019 recommends universal screening up to age 65.
textos.Sífilis: testar com risco aumentado: Syphilis: test when at increased risk
textos.Oferecer teste para sífilis (treponêmico: Offer a syphilis test (treponemal or VDRL) together with HIV testing to people at increased risk: key populations (MSM, trans people, sex workers), current or previous STI, multiple partners, condomless sex, PrEP use. The interval for each group is in Table 5 of PCDT-IST 2022.
textos.O motor segue o MS 2026 (PCDT Hepatite C: The engine follows MS 2026 (PCDT Hepatitis C), with no age limit for the one-time test. USPSTF 2020 recommends hepatitis C screening from 18 to 79.
textos.O motor segue o CDC 2023 e o MS (painel: The engine follows CDC 2023 and MS (panel once in adults without documented vaccination). USPSTF 2020 recommends screening only people at increased risk (B).
textos.Aneurisma de aorta: homem que nunca fumo: Aortic aneurysm: man who never smoked
textos.Ultrassonografia de aorta como oferta se: Aortic ultrasound as a selective offer (USPSTF C): decide with the patient, considering family history of aneurysm, other aneurysms, COPD or cardiovascular disease.
textos.Divergência entre diretrizes: densitomet: Guideline divergence: bone densitometry in men
textos.O motor não pede densitometria ao homem: The engine does not order bone densitometry for men without a risk factor (USPSTF 2025: insufficient evidence). BHOF 2022 recommends it from age 70, and from 50 to 69 with a risk factor: shared decision.
textos.Na pós-menopausa, calcular o FRAX (Brasi: After menopause, calculate FRAX (Brazil) if there is a risk factor for fracture (previous fragility fracture, glucocorticoids, smoking, low weight, excess alcohol, rheumatoid arthritis, hip fracture in a parent) and order bone densitometry if the risk is elevated.
textos.Anticoagulante oral direto: função renal: Direct oral anticoagulant: kidney function at least yearly (more often if CrCl < 60 mL/min or age ≥ 75) for dose adjustment.
textos.Morte súbita antes dos 50 anos em parent: Sudden death before age 50 in a first-degree relative: ECG and targeted clinical assessment (channelopathies, cardiomyopathies).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com QT longo, Brugada: First-degree relative with long QT, Brugada or another channelopathy: 12-lead ECG and assessment by a cardiologist.
textos.Pré-diabetes: reavaliar a glicemia ao me: Prediabetes: reassess glycemia at least once a year.
textos.Fratura de quadril em pai ou mãe é fator: A hip fracture in a parent is a major risk factor for fracture: screen before age 65 (postmenopausal women).

A hip fracture in a parent is a major risk factor for fracture: BHOF recommends bone densitometry in men aged 50 to 69 with a risk factor. Shared decision: for men, the USPSTF considers the evidence insufficient.
textos.HbA1c, lipídios, Lp(a), função renal, PS: HbA1c, lipids, Lp(a), kidney function, PSA…
textos.HbA1c ≥ 6,5% sem diagnóstico de diabetes: HbA1c ≥ 6.5% without a diagnosis of diabetes: repeat the HbA1c or, as an alternative, measure fasting plasma glucose. Without unequivocal hyperglycemia, the diagnosis requires two abnormal results (in the same sample or in separate samples).
HbA1c ≥ 6.5% without a diagnosis of diabetes
textos.TFG estimada < 60 sem diagnóstico de DRC: Estimated GFR < 60 without a diagnosis of CKD: repeat creatinine with estimated GFR (CKD-EPI 2021) in 3 months. A single result may be acute kidney injury; CKD requires an abnormality lasting 3 months or more.
Estimated GFR < 60 without a diagnosis of CKD: albuminuria together with the repeat GFR in 3 months, to confirm and stage CKD.
textos.TFG < 60 isolada, DRC a confirmar: Isolated GFR < 60, CKD to be confirmed
textos.Uma TFG estimada < 60 isolada não confir: A single estimated GFR < 60 does not confirm CKD: chronicity (3 months or more) must be shown, and a single result may be acute kidney injury. Review previous GFR and albuminuria; without them, repeat creatinine/GFR and uACR in 3 months. Once confirmed, check "Chronic kidney disease".
textos.HbA1c ≥ 6,5%: confirmar o diagnóstico de: HbA1c ≥ 6.5%: confirm the diagnosis of diabetes
textos.Sem diabetes marcado e sem antidiabético: Without diabetes checked and without an antidiabetic drug, a single HbA1c ≥ 6.5% does not confirm diabetes: without unequivocal hyperglycemia, two abnormal results are needed. Repeat the HbA1c or measure fasting plasma glucose. With unequivocal hyperglycemia (glucose ≥ 200 mg/dL with classic symptoms or a hyperglycemic crisis), which the form does not record, check diabetes and its type.
textos.HbA1c ≥ 6,5% isolada não confirma diabet: A single HbA1c ≥ 6.5% does not confirm diabetes (ADA 2026): the engine asks for a second test (HbA1c or fasting glucose) and does not check the box. With a confirmed diagnosis or unequivocal hyperglycemia, check the type of diabetes.
textos.1 dose a cada 6 meses. Conferir vacinas: 1 dose every 6 months. Check the vaccines available in the Brazilian National Immunization Program (PNI, gov.br/saude).
textos.1 dose a cada gestação, em qualquer idad: 1 dose in each pregnancy, at any gestational age (at least 6 months since the last dose). Check the vaccines available in the Brazilian National Immunization Program (PNI, gov.br/saude).
textos.1 dose por ano. Conferir vacinas disponí: 1 dose per year. Check the vaccines available in the Brazilian National Immunization Program (PNI, gov.br/saude).
textos.2 doses com intervalo de 3 meses (0-3),: 2 doses 3 months apart (0-3), regardless of prior dengue. Licensed from 4 to 60 years. Contraindicated in pregnant women, breastfeeding women and immunosuppressed people (including immunosuppressive therapy). 30-day interval from another live attenuated vaccine not given on the same day. textos.Dose única. Indicada em qualquer idade c: Single dose. Indicated at any age with a comorbidity that raises the risk of invasive pneumococcal disease (including HIV, chronic kidney disease, diabetes and immunosuppression). Already received PPSV23: wait 1 year.
textos.Esquema completo: reforço com dTpa a cad: Complete series: Tdap booster every 10 years. Incomplete: 1 dose of Tdap and complete with Td up to 3 doses with a tetanus component. Unvaccinated/unknown: 1 Tdap + 2 Td (0-2-4 to 8 months). Contact of an infant: consider bringing the booster forward to 5 years. Travel to an area with polio: Tdap-IPV. Pregnant woman: 1 dose of Tdap in each pregnancy, from 20 weeks; if not given during pregnancy, up to 45 days after delivery.

textos.Gestante | 1 dose a cada gestação a part: Pregnant woman | 1 dose in each pregnancy from 20 wk | PNI: yes

textos.Imunossupressão de baixo grau (metotrexa: Low-level immunosuppression (methotrexate ≤ 0.4 mg/kg/week or azathioprine ≤ 3 mg/kg/day): assess case by case. SBIm asks for 1 to 3 months off methotrexate and 3 months off azathioprine before a live vaccine.

textos.O motor seguiu a SBIm (a partir de 18 an: The engine followed SBIm (from 18 years in chronic cardiopulmonary disease and in moderate or severe immunodeficiency; routine from 70 years). ACIP recommends the vaccine from 75 years and, from 50 to 74, only with increased risk.
textos.O motor seguiu a SBIm e o PNI: a partir: The engine followed SBIm and the PNI: from 28 weeks, with no upper limit, 1 dose in each pregnancy. ACIP and ACOG recommend 32 to 36 weeks, during the season, and do not repeat the dose in a later pregnancy.
textos.O motor seguiu a SBIm e os CRIE, que não: The engine followed SBIm and the CRIE, which do not list smoking as a risk, and did not include PCV20. ACIP recommends PCV20 from 19 to 49 years in cigarette smokers (and in alcohol use disorder).
textos.O motor seguiu a SBIm: 2 doses com 2 mes: The engine followed SBIm: 2 doses 2 months apart in unvaccinated adults with asplenia or HIV. ACIP recommends a single dose in asplenia and does not recommend Hib for adults with HIV.
textos.O motor seguiu o ACIP: Bexsero® em 2 dos: The engine followed ACIP: Bexsero® in 2 doses 1 month apart, a booster 1 year later and every 2-3 years. SBIm recommends 3 doses (0, 1-2 and 6 months) up to 50 years, a booster 1 year later and every 3 years.
textos.Pessoa vivendo com HIV não vacinada: 2 d: Unvaccinated person living with HIV: 2 doses 2 months apart.
textos.Pessoa vivendo com HIV: 2 doses de ACWY: Person living with HIV: 2 doses of conjugate ACWY 8 weeks apart and a booster every 5 years.
textos.Pneumocócica no tabagismo antes dos 50 a: Pneumococcal vaccine in smokers under 50: guidelines differ
textos.SBIm/PNI: a partir de 28 semanas, sem li: SBIm/PNI: from 28 weeks, with no upper limit (except in labor), 1 dose in each pregnancy (24-27 weeks at the physician's discretion). Label: preferably from 24 to 36 weeks. ACIP/ACOG: 32 to 36 weeks, during the season, and no dose in a later pregnancy. The only RSV vaccine licensed for pregnant women.
textos.Se o transplante foi de células-tronco h: If the transplant was of hematopoietic stem cells, every vaccine given before must be repeated: inactivated vaccines from 3 to 6 months, influenza from 3 to 4 months and live-virus vaccines only after 24 months, without graft-versus-host disease and with immune reconstitution. Follow the transplant team's protocol.
textos.Sem fator de risco nas listas, a vacina: With no risk factor in the lists, the RSV vaccine was not added to the prescription. From 60 to 69 years, SBIm recommends it with heart disease, lung disease, diabetes, obesity, kidney disease, liver disease, immunosuppression, frailty or institutionalization; routine use starts at 70.
textos.VSR de 60 a 69 anos: só com fator de ris: RSV from 60 to 69 years: only with a risk factor
textos.Vacina de vírus vivo atenuado durante o: Live attenuated vaccine during systemic cancer treatment: decide with the oncology team. Ideally give it 3 to 4 weeks before starting treatment (at least 15 days).
textos.Vacina de vírus vivo atenuado em pessoa: Live attenuated vaccine in a person living with HIV with CD4+ T cells of 350 cells/mm³ or more: SBIm considers immunosuppression mild or absent and the vaccine can be given; it stays off the automatic list for the physician to confirm.
textos.Vacina inativada: 2 doses (0-2 meses; in: Inactivated vaccine: 2 doses (0-2 months; minimum interval of 1 month), even after herpes zoster. Indicated from 18 years in immunocompromised people, in cancer (preferably before treatment) and in every person living with HIV, whatever the CD4+ T-cell count.
textos.Asplenia: aplicar duas doses (0,5 ml), I: Asplenia: give two doses (0.5 mL), INTRAMUSCULAR, 2 months apart, if not previously vaccinated (SBIm/CRIE; ACIP recommends a single dose).
textos.HIV: aplicar duas doses (0,5 ml), INTRAM: HIV: give two doses (0.5 mL), INTRAMUSCULAR, 8 weeks apart. Booster every 5 years.
HIV: give two doses (0.5 mL), INTRAMUSCULAR, 2 months apart, if not previously vaccinated.
textos.Corticoide sistêmico sem dose ou duração: Systemic corticosteroid without dose or duration entered
textos.Metotrexato ou azatioprina em dose de ba: Methotrexate or azathioprine at a low-level dose
textos.Asplenia: 3 doses (0, 1-2 e 6 meses); re: Asplenia: 3 doses (0, 1-2 and 6 months); a booster 1 year after the series and then every 2-3 years (ACIP) or every 3 years (SBIm). All doses from the same manufacturer. Licensed up to 50 years.
textos.ACIP e SBIm concordam no esquema de 3 do: ACIP and SBIm agree on the 3-dose series (0, 1-2 and 6 months) and on the first booster 1 year later. They differ on later boosters: every 2-3 years per ACIP and every 3 years per SBIm. The engine shows both intervals.
textos.Asplenia: aplicar três doses (0,5 ml), I: Asplenia: give three doses (0.5 mL), INTRAMUSCULAR, at 0, 1-2 and 6 months (Bexsero®). Booster 1 year after the series and then every 2-3 years (ACIP) or 3 years (SBIm).
textos.O motor seguiu a SBIm: 2 doses com inter: The engine followed SBIm: 2 doses at least 1 month apart. ACIP recommends MenB-4C (Bexsero®) from 16 to 23 years by shared clinical decision-making, in 2 doses at 0 and 6 months, and outside that range only with increased risk.
textos.Creatinina > 1,1 mg/dL (ou o dobro da ba: Creatinine > 1.1 mg/dL (or double the baseline) is a severe feature.
textos.Transaminases no dobro do normal são sin: Transaminases at twice the upper limit of normal are a severe feature.
textos.Ainda pode ser iniciado até 28 semanas (: It can still be started up to 28 weeks (ACOG), with less benefit than before 16: aspirin 100-150 mg at night (ideally 150 mg) until 36 weeks.
textos.Iniciar a partir de 12 semanas, idealmen: Start from 12 weeks, ideally before 16: aspirin 100-150 mg at night (ideally 150 mg) until 36 weeks.
textos.Iniciar agora (idealmente antes de 16 se: Start now (ideally before 16 weeks): aspirin 100-150 mg at night (ideally 150 mg) until 36 weeks.
textos.Não iniciar depois de 28 semanas. Se est: Do not start after 28 weeks. If already in use, FEBRASGO stops it at 36 weeks.
textos.Não iniciar depois de 28 semanas. Se já: Do not start after 28 weeks. If already in use, continue until 36 weeks.
textos.Exame basal, para comparação se surgir h: Baseline test, for comparison if hypertension develops.
textos.1 dose de dTpa em toda gestação a partir: 1 dose of Tdap in every pregnancy from 20 weeks, regardless of the interval since the last dose. If not vaccinated during pregnancy, vaccinate as soon as possible postpartum.
textos.1 dose em cada gestação, em qualquer ida: 1 dose in each pregnancy, at any gestational age (PNI/SBIm).

textos.Amamentando criança com menos de 6 meses: Breastfeeding a child under 6 months: lipids rise in pregnancy and are screened after the postpartum period; HbA1c in the first weeks after delivery is affected by pregnancy and blood loss. If delivery was less than 12 weeks ago, prefer to postpone these tests.
textos.Avaliar a vitalidade fetal e encaminhar: Assess fetal well-being and refer to the maternity hospital at 41 weeks to plan delivery.
textos.Sem CD4 anterior: pedir agora. Na gestaç: No previous CD4: order now. In pregnancy: at the first visit; on ART with undetectable viral load, again at 34 weeks; when starting treatment, at least every 3 months.
textos.Sem carga viral anterior: pedir agora. N: No previous viral load: order now. In pregnancy, at least 3 times: at the first visit, 2-4 weeks after starting or changing ART, and from 34 weeks (defines the mode of delivery).
textos.Clamídia: rastreio na primeira consulta: Chlamydia: screening at the first visit for all (Williams). Gonorrhea: for those under 25 or with a risk factor. Repeat in the 3rd trimester if under 25 or at risk.
textos.Com 37 semanas ou mais o TOTG muda pouco: At 37 weeks or more the OGTT changes management little: decide case by case (fasting glucose or OGTT).
textos.Confirme a tipagem ABO/Rh da 1ª consulta: Confirm the ABO/Rh typing from the first visit. If Rh negative: indirect Coombs test at 28 weeks and anti-D immunoglobulin at 28 weeks and within 72 h after delivery (Rh-positive newborn).
textos.Considerados já feitos: tipagem ABO/Rh,: Considered already done: ABO/Rh typing, indirect Coombs test, complete blood count, fasting glucose, urinalysis and urine culture, HIV, syphilis, HBsAg, anti-HCV, TSH, chlamydia, toxoplasmosis, rubella and cytomegalovirus. If any is missing, answer "Yes" to "First prenatal visit?" or add the test when generating the PDF.
textos.Crescimento fetal no 3º trimestre: proto: Third-trimester fetal growth: institutional protocol (Einstein). Routine Doppler has no demonstrated benefit in low-risk pregnancy (Cochrane 2015).
textos.1º trimestre, a cada trimestre e até 1 a: 1st trimester, every trimester and up to 1 year postpartum
textos.Datação, número de fetos, rastreamento d: Dating, number of fetuses, screening for aneuploidies and anomalies; preeclampsia risk assessment (uterine artery Doppler). Biochemical screening or cell-free fetal DNA are optional. Twins: determine chorionicity.
Defines intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis. Not needed if there was group B streptococcal bacteriuria in this pregnancy or a previous infant with group B streptococcal disease: in those cases prophylaxis is given anyway.
textos.Febre amarela: contraindicada em nutrize: Yellow fever: contraindicated in nursing mothers until the child is 6 months old. If vaccination is unavoidable, suspend breastfeeding for 10 days.
textos.Diabetes gestacional: TOTG 75 g (jejum e: Gestational diabetes: 75 g OGTT (fasting and 2 h) at 4-12 weeks after delivery, more sensitive than HbA1c. If already done, screening continues at least every 3 years.
textos.Diabetes gestacional: pedir com 4-12 sem: Gestational diabetes: order at 4-12 weeks after delivery (more sensitive than HbA1c); then lifelong screening, at least every 3 years.
textos.Diabetes pré-gestacional: rastreio de ca: Pregestational diabetes: screening for congenital heart disease in the 2nd trimester.

textos.Fundo de olho antes da gestação ou no 1º: Eye exam before pregnancy or in the 1st trimester, every trimester and up to 1 year postpartum. HbA1c is a secondary measure in pregnancy (the main one is capillary glucose). Calcium, phosphorus and vitamin D are not screened in pregnancy.
textos.Gemelar monocoriônica: ultrassonografia: Monochorionic twins: ultrasound every 2 weeks from 16 weeks (twin-twin transfusion syndrome, selective growth restriction).

textos.1ª consulta, 2-4 semanas após iniciar ou: First visit, 2-4 weeks after starting or changing ART, and from 34 weeks
textos.Gestante com HIV: a partir de 34 semanas: Pregnant woman with HIV: from 34 weeks, defines the mode of delivery.

textos.Metabolismo ósseo do diabético não se ra: Bone metabolism of people with diabetes is not screened in pregnancy (vitamin D: ACOG CO 495).
textos.Na gestação a HbA1c é medida secundária: In pregnancy HbA1c is a secondary measure of control (the main one is capillary glucose).
textos.Na gestação, PA ≥ 140/90 é avaliada pelo: In pregnancy, BP ≥ 140/90 is assessed by prenatal care (gestational hypertension or preeclampsia), not by outpatient hypertension confirmation.
textos.Não faz parte do pré-natal de risco habi: Not part of low-risk prenatal care (Brazilian Ministry of Health, CAB 32); with hypertension, diabetes, kidney disease or risk of preeclampsia, prenatal care orders it.
Not part of low-risk prenatal care (Brazilian Ministry of Health, CAB 32); order if clinically indicated.
textos.O motor segue ACOG/Williams (repetir com: The engine follows ACOG/Williams (repeat at 28 weeks and give anti-D immunoglobulin); the Brazilian Ministry of Health (CAB 32) repeats the indirect Coombs test every 4 weeks from 24 weeks.
textos.O motor segue a FEBRASGO 2023 e a Conite: The engine follows FEBRASGO 2023 and Conitec 2026 (100-150 mg at night, until 36 weeks); USPSTF 2021 and ACOG use 81 mg/day, started between 12 and 28 weeks and continued until delivery.
textos.O motor segue a FEBRASGO/SBEM 2022 (TSH: The engine follows FEBRASGO/SBEM 2022 (TSH for all at the start of prenatal care); ATA 2017 and ACOG screen selectively (thyroid disease, type 1 diabetes or another autoimmune disease, positive anti-TPO, age > 30, BMI ≥ 40, previous miscarriage or preterm birth, neck irradiation, amiodarone or lithium).
textos.O motor segue a USPSTF 2021 (todas as mu: The engine follows USPSTF 2021 (all sexually active women up to age 24, annually); the 2025 Brazilian Ministry of Health technical note restricts the test in the public health system (SUS) to vulnerable populations.
textos.O motor segue o Williams (clamídia para: The engine follows Williams (chlamydia for all at the first visit); USPSTF 2021 screens pregnant women aged 25 or older only with increased risk (new or multiple partners, a partner with an STI, previous STI).

textos.Gemelar: definir a corionicidade na ultr: Twins: determine chorionicity on the 11-14 week ultrasound; monochorionic twins need ultrasound every 2 weeks from 16 weeks (check "Monochorionic twins").

textos.PAS ≥ 160 ou PAD ≥ 110: repetir em 15 mi: SBP ≥ 160 or DBP ≥ 110: repeat within 15 minutes to confirm; if it persists, treat within 30-60 minutes (intravenous labetalol or hydralazine, or immediate-release oral nifedipine) and refer to the maternity hospital to evaluate preeclampsia with severe features.
textos.Protocolo Einstein; não é rastreio de ro: Einstein protocol; not routine screening per ACOG.
textos.Puerpério recente: lípides e HbA1c: Recent postpartum period: lipids and HbA1c
textos.Rastrear (teste molecular) se houver ris: Screen (molecular test) if there is increased risk: new or multiple partners, a partner with an STI, previous STI, exchanging sex for money or drugs.
textos.Rastreio universal no início do pré-nata: Universal screening at the start of prenatal care. Without a local trimester-specific reference: TSH ≤ 4.0 mIU/L is normal; above that, measure free T4 (TSH > 10: overt hypothyroidism, treat).
textos.Retinopatia pode progredir na gestação:: Retinopathy may progress in pregnancy: dilated eye exam in the 1st trimester, every trimester and up to 1 year postpartum, according to the degree of retinopathy.
textos.Se a sífilis e o HIV do 3º trimestre não: If third-trimester syphilis and HIV tests were not done, test now or at admission for delivery (rapid tests).
textos.Seguimento de HAS fora da gestação. Na g: Hypertension follow-up outside pregnancy. In pregnancy, the assessment is that of prenatal care (protein/creatinine, platelets, creatinine and transaminases).
textos.Sífilis e HIV no fim da gestação: Syphilis and HIV at the end of pregnancy
textos.Só com sintomas respiratórios ou para af: Only with respiratory symptoms or to rule out active tuberculosis before treating latent infection (with abdominal shielding); not a routine test in pregnancy.
textos.Teste molecular (urina ou swab vaginal): Annual molecular test (urine or vaginal swab) in sexually active women up to age 24.
textos.Atividade sexual não informada: não se a: Sexual activity not provided: does not apply to those who are not sexually active.
textos.Ácido fólico 0,4 mg/dia (idealmente desd: Folic acid 0.4 mg/day (ideally from before conception) and elemental iron 40 mg/day during pregnancy, iron until the 3rd month postpartum (Brazilian Ministry of Health). Calcium ≥ 1 g/day in the second half of pregnancy reduces preeclampsia in those with low calcium intake (FEBRASGO; conflicting evidence for general use).
textos.Ácido fólico 0,4-0,8 mg/dia para quem pl: Folic acid 0.4-0.8 mg/day for those planning or able to become pregnant, from at least 1 month before conception through 2-3 months of pregnancy (prevention of neural tube defects).
textos.Ácido fólico se pode engravidar: Folic acid if able to become pregnant
textos.Mais de 10 anos desde a última gestação: More than 10 years since the last pregnancy
textos.Desfecho adverso prévio (baixo peso, PIG: Previous adverse outcome (low birth weight, SGA, stillbirth)
textos.Risco de pré-eclâmpsia (fatores moderado: Preeclampsia risk (moderate-risk factors and combined screening)

textos.Idade do familiar mais jovem ao diagnóst: Age of the youngest relative at diagnosis
textos.Opcional. Antes dos 60 anos, a colonosco: Optional. Before age 60, colonoscopy starts at 40 or 10 years before that age, whichever comes first.
textos.Idade do familiar mais jovem com câncer: Age of the youngest relative with colorectal cancer
textos.A história familiar preenche critério pa: The family history meets a criterion for genetic testing. Triple-negative breast cancer in a close relative, at any age. Refer for genetic counseling. Ideally, test the relative with cancer first; if that is not possible, test the patient with a panel that includes BRCA1, BRCA2 and PALB2.
textos.BRCA1/2 na família: rastreamento de cânc: BRCA1/2 in the family: prostate cancer screening from age 40 in BRCA2 carriers (consider in BRCA1), with shared decision-making, up to age 69.
textos.Colonoscopia a cada 10 anos (45-75 anos): Colonoscopy every 10 years (45-75 years). Alternative: yearly fecal immunochemical test (FIT) for occult blood. Choose one of the two methods with the patient and remove the other.
textos.Colonoscopia de rastreio adiada para apó: Screening colonoscopy postponed until after pregnancy (during pregnancy, only with a diagnostic indication).
textos.Câncer colorretal: as diretrizes diverge: Colorectal cancer: guidelines differ on starting age and method
textos.Câncer de mama em parente de 1º grau: ri: Breast cancer in a first-degree relative: higher than average risk; yearly mammography from 40 to 74. Calculate the lifetime breast cancer risk (Tyrer-Cuzick/IBIS): 20% or more indicates added yearly MRI.
textos.Câncer de pulmão: as diretrizes divergem: Lung cancer: guidelines differ for those who quit smoking 15 or more years ago
textos.Câncer de pulmão: informe há quantos ano: Lung cancer: enter how many years ago the patient quit smoking to assess low-dose CT (50-80 years, 20 or more pack-years, current smoker or quit less than 15 years ago).
textos.Câncer de pulmão: informe os maços-ano p: Lung cancer: enter the pack-years to assess low-dose CT (50-80 years, 20 or more pack-years, current smoker or quit less than 15 years ago).
textos.Decisão compartilhada: pedir só depois d: Shared decision-making: order only after discussing benefits (a small reduction in prostate cancer mortality) and harms (false positives, biopsy, overdiagnosis, incontinence and erectile dysfunction from treatment). Do not order for those who, after the discussion, do not express a preference for screening. Interval of 2 to 4 years.
textos.Depois dos 85 anos o rastreio não é reco: After age 85 screening is not recommended; colonoscopy only to investigate symptoms.
textos.Endoscopia eletiva (rastreio ou vigilânc: Elective endoscopy (screening or surveillance) postponed until after delivery; during pregnancy, only with a strong indication.
textos.Indicam avaliação em centro de referênci: Referral to a reference center (MRI or endoscopic ultrasound) is indicated by: two or more affected relatives on the same side of the family, at least one of them first-degree; or a pathogenic risk variant (BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, Lynch syndrome) with an affected relative; or a high-risk syndrome (Peutz-Jeghers, CDKN2A). A single affected relative, with no known variant, does not indicate screening.
textos.Mamografia de rastreio adiada para após: Screening mammography postponed until after pregnancy and breastfeeding (investigate if there is a clinical finding).
textos.Mamografia: as diretrizes divergem no in: Mammography: guidelines differ on interval and starting age
textos.O motor seguiu o USPSTF 2018: PSA por de: The engine followed USPSTF 2018: PSA by shared decision-making from 55 to 69 and no screening from age 70. The Brazilian Ministry of Health/INCA (Technical Note 9/2023) does not recommend population screening: only shared decision-making with those who ask for the test. SBU, SBOC and SBRT propose an individual discussion from age 50 with life expectancy over 10 years, and from 40 to 50 with family history, Black ethnicity or a BRCA mutation.
textos.O motor seguiu o USPSTF 2021 e a USMSTF: The engine followed USPSTF 2021 and USMSTF 2022: screening from age 45, with colonoscopy every 10 years or yearly FIT (the physician chooses one of the two). The Brazilian Ministry of Health/INCA (2026) adopted FIT as the SUS test for asymptomatic people aged 50 to 75, with colonoscopy if positive, and does not screen before 50.
textos.O motor seguiu o USPSTF 2021 e o consens: The engine followed USPSTF 2021 and the Brazilian consensus (SBCT/SBPT/CBR 2024), which do not indicate low-dose CT after 15 years without smoking. ACS 2023 does not use time since quitting and would include this patient (50-80 years, 20 or more pack-years), with shared decision-making.
textos.O motor seguiu o USPSTF 2024: mamografia: The engine followed USPSTF 2024: biennial mammography from 40 to 74. CBR/SBM/FEBRASGO 2023: yearly from 40 to 74. textos.O rastreio de rotina vai até os 74 anos,: Routine screening goes up to age 74, also with family history. textos.A SBC 2025 inclui o ácido úrico nos exam: SBC 2025 includes uric acid in the routine tests for hypertension; AHA/ACC treats it as an optional test, without serial repetition. We suggest one measurement at the initial evaluation.
textos.ACIP e SBIm concordam no esquema de 3 do: ACIP and SBIm agree on the 3-dose schedule (0, 1-2 and 6 months) and on the first booster 1 year later. They differ on later boosters: every 2-3 years per ACIP and every 3 years per SBIm. We show both intervals.
textos.Acima de 70 anos, só sugerimos rastrear: Above 70 years, we only suggest screening with BMI ≥ 25 and a risk factor (USPSTF 2021: screening from 35 to 70 years). ADA 2026 has no stopping age: consider it if life expectancy justifies.
textos.Até 30 anos, nós optamos por seguir a re: Up to 30 years, we chose to follow the PCDT-IST 2022 reference (annual test). USPSTF 2019 asks for at least one test from 15 to 65 years and repetition only with increased risk.
textos.Colonoscopia a cada 10 anos (45-75 anos): Colonoscopy every 10 years (45-75 years). Alternative: annual fecal immunochemical test (FIT). We suggest choosing one of the two methods with the patient and removing the other.
textos.Com PA de 130-139/80-89 mmHg, nós optamo: With BP of 130-139/80-89 mmHg, we chose to follow the AHA/ACC 2025 reference (stage 1 hypertension, to be confirmed with HBPM or ABPM). SBC 2025 calls this range prehypertension and only considers hypertension from 140/90 mmHg.
textos.Mulher pós-menopausa com menos de 65 ano: Postmenopausal woman under 65 years with a fracture risk factor: calculate FRAX (Brazil) and order densitometry if the risk is elevated. We suggest confirming that the patient is postmenopausal.
textos.No tipo 1, a uACR e a TFG anuais começam: In type 1, annual uACR and eGFR start 5 years after diagnosis (in type 2, from diagnosis). We have no way to know the duration of diabetes: the uACR can be removed if the diagnosis is less than 5 years old and there is no other indication.
textos.Não sugerimos densitometria ao homem sem: We do not suggest densitometry for men without a risk factor (USPSTF 2025: insufficient evidence). BHOF 2022 recommends it from 70 years, and from 50 to 69 with a risk factor: shared decision.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da A: We chose to follow the ACOG and Williams reference (repeat at 28 weeks and give anti-D immunoglobulin); the Ministry of Health (CAB 32) repeats the indirect Coombs every 4 weeks from 24 weeks.
We chose to follow the ADA 2026 reference (screening from 35 years, whatever the weight). USPSTF 2021 restricts screening from 35 to 70 years to people with overweight or obesity.

We chose to follow the AHA/ACC 2025 reference: echocardiogram only with an indication (ECG with left ventricular hypertrophy, suspected heart failure, hard-to-control hypertension). SBC 2025 includes the echocardiogram in the evaluation of cardiac target-organ damage.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da F: We chose to follow the FEBRASGO 2023 and Conitec 2026 reference (100-150 mg at night, until 36 weeks); USPSTF 2021 and ACOG use 81 mg/day, started at 12 to 28 weeks and continued until delivery.

We chose to follow the FEBRASGO/SBEM 2022 reference (TSH for all at the start of prenatal care); ATA 2017 and ACOG screen selectively (thyroid disease, type 1 or other autoimmune diabetes, positive anti-TPO, age > 30, BMI ≥ 40, previous miscarriage or preterm birth, neck irradiation, amiodarone or lithium).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da S: We chose to follow the SBIm reference (from 18 years in chronic cardiopulmonary disease and moderate or severe immunodeficiency; routine from 70 years). ACIP recommends the vaccine from 75 years and, from 50 to 74, only with increased risk.

We chose to follow the SBIm and PNI reference: from 28 weeks, with no upper limit, 1 dose in each pregnancy. ACIP and ACOG recommend 32 to 36 weeks, during the season, and do not repeat the dose in a later pregnancy.

We chose to follow the SBIm and CRIE reference, which do not list smoking as a risk, and did not include PCV20. ACIP recommends PCV20 from 19 to 49 years in cigarette smokers (and in alcohol use disorder).
We chose to follow the SBIm reference: 2 doses 2 months apart in unvaccinated adults with asplenia or HIV. ACIP recommends a single dose in asplenia and does not recommend Hib in adults with HIV.

We chose to follow the SBIm reference: 2 doses at least 1 month apart. ACIP recommends MenB-4C (Bexsero®) from 16 to 23 years by shared decision, in 2 doses at 0 and 6 months, and outside this range only with increased risk.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da U: We chose to follow the USPSTF 2021 reference (all sexually active women up to 24 years, annually); the Ministry of Health 2025 technical note restricts the test in the SUS to vulnerable populations.
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência da b: We chose to follow the US label reference for neutrophils (weekly up to 6 months, every 2 weeks up to 12 months and monthly after); the Brazilian label asks for weekly up to 18 weeks and monthly after. textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do C: We chose to follow the CDC 2023 and Ministry of Health reference (panel once in adults without documented vaccination). USPSTF 2020 recommends screening only people with increased risk (B).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do P: We chose to follow the Ministry of Health PCDT reference for all tenofovir (creatinine and urinalysis every 3-6 months). HIVMA/IDSA accepts longer intervals with tenofovir alafenamide (TAF), less nephrotoxic than the fumarate (TDF).
textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do U: We chose to follow the USPSTF 2018 reference: PSA by shared decision from 55 to 69 years and no screening from 70. textos.Nós optamos por seguir a referência do W: We chose to follow the Williams reference (chlamydia for all at the 1st visit); USPSTF 2021 screens pregnant women from 25 years only with increased risk (new or multiple partners, partner with an STI, previous STI).

textos.Sem HAS, não sugerimos ECG ao diabético: Without hypertension, we do not suggest an ECG for asymptomatic people with diabetes (ADA 2026: do not screen for coronary disease in asymptomatic people). ACCF/AHA 2010 considers a baseline ECG reasonable (IIa): order it if the physician chooses to.
textos.Sugerimos a 25(OH)D basal no uso de cort: We suggest baseline 25(OH)D with corticosteroid use for 3 months or more (Sparling 2024). textos.Sugerimos a relação aldosterona/renina n: We suggest the aldosterone/renin ratio in resistant hypertension (AHA/ACC 2025, class 1, with any potassium) and in hypertension with sleep apnea (Endocrine Society 2016). We also suggest screening with spontaneous or diuretic-induced hypokalemia, adrenal incidentaloma, persistent BP ≥ 150/100 or family history of hypertension or stroke before 40 years. textos.Sugerimos confirmar a tipagem ABO/Rh da: We suggest confirming the ABO/Rh typing from the 1st visit. If Rh negative: indirect Coombs at 28 weeks and anti-D immunoglobulin at 28 weeks and up to 72 h after delivery (Rh-positive newborn).
textos.Sugerimos rastrear (teste molecular) se: We suggest screening (molecular test) if there is increased risk: new or multiple partners, partner with an STI, previous STI, exchanging sex for money or drugs.
textos.Sugerimos rastrear e tratar hipertensão,: We suggest screening for and treating hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia, obesity and kidney disease, common in gout, and avoiding diuretics to treat hypertension when there is an alternative.
textos.Triagem de hepatite B na avaliação inici: Hepatitis B screening at the initial evaluation. Reactive HBsAg: HBV viral load. We suggest vaccinating non-immune people; with reactive anti-HBs there is no need to repeat. Repeat serology before switching to a regimen without tenofovir.
